title: Data Analyst - OpenData Commercial - Asia Pacific
description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.
## The Role
As Data Analyst working on Veeva OpenData, you will be instrumental in building a high-quality data product. You will be identifying and analyzing data quality issues, integrating data sources and improving processes. By taking full ownership of the work, you will become a subject matter expert and a key member of a high performing team.
## What You’ll Do
• Identify and analyze data quality issues
• Build quality checks, validation rules and other processes to ensure data quality
• Develop and build ad hoc data transformations to clean data and fix quality issues
• Analyze, clean and onboard new data sources
• Work with product managers to understand data quality requirements, data sources and maintenance requirements
• Coordinate with other Data Analysts on common processes, best practices, as well as peer reviews
## Requirements
• Excellent attention to detail, a meticulous approach, especially when working with data
• 3+ years of experience working as a Data Analyst or in a similar role.
• Strong SQL skills including a good understanding of relational database schemas
• Able to document work with precision and clarity
• Good written and verbal communications skills in English
## Nice to Have
• Prior experience with customer reference data for the life sciences industry
• Experience with relational database administration
## Perks & Benefits
• Flexible “work from anywhere” policy
Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.
Veeva is an equal opportunity employer. title: AI Augmented Fullstack | Remote in Mexico
description:
Important IT company At the Latin American level, growth requires:
## AI Augmented Fullstack
## Role overview
We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Developer to build and maintain a multi-service application using C#, Core, React, TypeScript, and Azure. The role includes integration with the planned DataFusion backend platform using PostgreSQL, Delta Lake tables, and Databricks. The developer will own implementation, integration, reliability, security, and production support.
The developer will use AI coding assistants to accelerate delivery while validating generated code and ensuring independently developed services work together consistently.
## Key responsibilities
Design and develop REST APIs and background workers using C# and Core.
Build React interfaces and integrate micro frontends with clear shell and remote boundaries.
Implement asynchronous communication using Azure Service Bus queues, topics, and subscriptions.
Define API and event contracts, including versioning and backward compatibility.
Develop and optimize PostgreSQL queries, stored procedures, and functions where appropriate; manage indexing, transactions, schema migrations, and database performance.
Integrate APIs and services with the planned DataFusion backend platform through defined interfaces and data contracts, using PostgreSQL and Delta Lake tables according to workload requirements.
Develop, integrate, and troubleshoot Databricks data workflows using SQL and Python/PySpark as appropriate, including ingestion, transformation, Delta table updates, data validation, and job monitoring.
Review and improve AI-generated code for correctness, maintainability, security, and performance.
Write appropriate units, integration, contracts, and end-to-end tests.
Implement authentication, authorization, structured logging, tracing, and monitoring.
Maintain CI/CD pipelines, support releases, investigate incidents, and document architecture decisions.
## Required technical skills
Years of experience: 8+ years of professional C#/.NET development, with hands-on delivery of production applications. Working experience with React, Databricks, PostgreSQL, and Delta Lake is required.
Backend development: C#, Core, REST APIs, dependency injection, async/await, cancellation, background services, validation, and consistent API error handling.
Frontend development: React, TypeScript, hooks, routing, state management, HTML, CSS, accessibility, and browser debugging.
Micro frontends: Module Federation or equivalent integration approach; shared dependencies, routing, authentication integration, CSS isolation, and independent deployments.
Messaging and distributed systems: Azure Service Bus settlement, message locks, retries, dead-letter queues, duplicate delivery, ordering, eventual consistency, service boundaries, and failure recovery.
Data and security: PostgreSQL, SQL, EF Core with Npgsql, transactions, indexing, migrations, concurrency, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, authorization, managed identities, and secrets management. Understanding transactional PostgreSQL and analytical Delta Lake workloads is required.
Databricks and Delta Lake: Hands-on working experience with Databricks notebooks, SQL, jobs/workflows, and Python/PySpark for relevant data tasks. Experience with Delta tables, schema enforcement and evolution, MERGE/upserts, incremental processing, data quality, and performance troubleshooting.
DataFusion backend integration: Ability to integrate .NET applications with the planned DataFusion platform, define API and data contracts, and work with PostgreSQL and Delta Lake-backed datasets through supported interfaces. Understanding data ownership, consistency, access controls, and operational failure handling.
Testing and delivery: xUnit or equivalent, React Testing Library, Git, Docker, CI/CD, Azure hosting, Application Insights, and distributed tracing.
AI application integration: Working understanding of agent workflows, tool/function calling, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Ability to integrate AI capabilities with .NET APIs and business applications while applying output validation, access controls, and guardrails.
AI-assisted engineering: Proficiency with AI coding assistants and the ability to validate generated code and dependencies, maintain shared engineering instructions, and apply sound judgment to architecture, security, performance, and test coverage.
## Good to have - Agentic AI experience
Agent frameworks: Hands-on experience with Microsoft Agent Framework, Semantic Kernel, LangChain, LangGraph, or an equivalent framework.
RAG and enterprise knowledge: Experience with document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector/hybrid search, grounding, citations, and enterprise knowledge bases.
Microsoft AI platform: Familiarity with Microsoft Foundry, Azure AI Search, and related Azure AI and model services.
Agent integration and reliability: Experience integrating agents with .NET APIs, databases, tools, or MCP servers, with awareness of evaluation, guardrails, access controls, human approval, token usage, latency, and cost optimization.
ADVANCED CONVERSATIONAL ENGLISH AND SPANISH ESSENTIAL (Will be evaluated).
If you are a foreingner residing in Mexico, you must have a valid INE, CURP, NSS and RFC.
Job type: Remote.
Location: Mexico -This position is fully remote; however, candidates must be currently residing in Mexico.
Salary: $100,000 MXN gross
Benefits: Excellent superior benefits.

title: AI Engineer, Specialist - Remote
description:
## Our Benefits:
Our team members enjoy a robust benefits package including:
• Competitive compensation
• Paid time off for vacations, holidays, and illness
• Comprehensive health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription)
• 401(k) retirement savings plan
• Education support and student loan assistance
• Life and disability insurance
• Flexible spending account
## Job Summary
The AI Engineer Specialist serves as a senior hands-on Subject Matter Expert (SME) within the CHS Enterprise AI Center of Excellence (CoE), operating under a collaborative hub-and-spoke model. Bridging deep machine learning engineering with modern agentic architecture, this role builds reusable "golden-path" blueprints, customizes foundation and domain-specific models on Google Cloud (Vertex AI), and embeds automated safety and observability guardrails into production. You will solve complex, high-stakes healthcare and clinical AI challenges across Generative AI, Agentic workflows, and Predictive/ML patterns while enabling business and technology spoke teams to scale safely across the enterprise.
## Key Responsibilities
Reference Architectures & "Golden Path" Engineering: Design, build, and harden reusable, pre-secured code templates and component libraries across CHS's three core AI patterns: GenAI (grounded assistants), Agentic workflows, and Predictive/ML pipelines.
Model Customization & Clinical NLP Optimization: Evaluate when foundation models (via Vertex AI Model Garden, including Gemini and open-weight models) require domain adaptation. Lead parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT/LoRA), retrieval/grounding optimization, and clinical terminology integration (SNOMED-CT, RxNorm, ICD-10/11) for high-precision healthcare use cases.
Agentic Systems & AI-for-BI Delivery (Spoke Execution): Serve as a lead hands-on builder for CoE-led flagship initiatives—engineering multi-agent orchestration (using Google ADK, Agent Runtime, Sessions/Memory Bank), Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool servers on Cloud Run, and enterprise AI/BI data agents (e.g., Looker Data Agents and master orchestrators).
Guardrails as Code & Automated Evaluation: Operationalize AI Governance Committee (AIGC) policies into automated pipeline controls—implementing Model Armor ingress/egress scanning, sensitive-data (PHI/PII) filters, custom Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) approval workflows, and automated quality/groundedness/drift evaluation suites.
AI Economics, Performance & Observability: Optimize latency, throughput, and token efficiency across multi-step agent runs. Instrument all solutions with OpenTelemetry traces, HIPAA/CMS compliance audit logs (capturing prompts, tool calls, and data access), and FinOps cost-per-solution telemetry routed through the Enterprise AI Gateway.
Spoke Enablement & Readiness Stewardship: Partner with business and technology spoke teams through design reviews, developer office hours, and structured production-readiness milestones (Design Review, Non-Prod Readiness, Production Promotion, and Post-Deployment Review) to accelerate safe launches.
## Minimum Qualifications
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, Biomedical Informatics, or a related quantitative engineering field required; Master’s degree preferred.
Experience: 8–10 years of deep Machine Learning, NLP, and AI engineering experience, including hands-on experience designing and shipping production Generative AI, RAG, or multi-agent applications into enterprise cloud environments.
## Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
• Strong proficiency in Python, PyTorch, and the Hugging Face ecosystem, paired with hands-on mastery of GCP Vertex AI (Model Garden, Agent Development Kit [ADK], Agent Gateway, Model Armor, Cloud Run) and working familiarity with Azure/Copilot environments.
• Deep experience engineering production CI/CD pipelines for AI workloads with strict dev/QA/prod environment separation, least-privilege IAM/agent identity controls, and OpenTelemetry-based observability and token cost tracking.
• Working knowledge of healthcare IT standards and clinical terminologies (FHIR, HL7, SNOMED-CT, RxNorm, ICD-10/11), combined with practical experience enforcing HIPAA and CMS data privacy and auditability requirements.
• Ability to translate abstract clinical or business use cases into well-architected multi-step agent workflows, balancing model accuracy, latency, and unit economics to deliver reliable, production-ready solutions.
This is a fully remote opportunity
This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship now or in the future. Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. for any employer.
We know it’s not just about finding a job. It’s about finding a place where you are respected, valued and where your work is purposeful and fulfilling. A place where your talent is recognized, professional development is encouraged and career advancement is possible.
Community Health Systems is one of the nation's leading healthcare providers. With healthcare delivery systems in 36 distinct markets across 14 states, CHS operates 69 affiliated hospitals with more than 10,000 beds and approximately 1,000 other sites of care, including physician practices, urgent care centers, freestanding emergency departments, imaging centers, cancer centers, and ambulatory surgery centers.

description:
## About Smart Working
At Smart Working, we believe your job should not only look right on paper but also feel right every day. This isn’t just another remote opportunity - it’s about finding where you truly belong, no matter where you are. Join one of the highest-rated workplaces on Glassdoor and experience what it means to thrive in a truly remote-first world.
## About the Role
As an AI Search Analyst, you will measure how a leading UK online electrical retailer appears in AI-powered search and translate those insights into meaningful business decisions. With customers increasingly relying on AI assistants for product recommendations, understanding AI visibility and its commercial impact is essential.
You will take ownership of AI search measurement within a fully embedded AEO/GEO programme, working closely with the AEO/GEO Lead, commercial analytics, paid search, trading and senior marketing stakeholders.
You will establish reliable measurement frameworks, improve attribution and deliver actionable insights that help senior leaders evaluate performance, prioritise improvements and understand the impact of AI search on revenue.
## Responsibilities
• Own end-to-end AI search measurement, benchmarking and reporting.
• Run weekly AI visibility benchmarks across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot and Google's AI experiences, covering large appliances, TV and audio, mobiles, small appliances and smart home categories.
• Automate prompt testing, scoring and data collection using LLM APIs and visibility platforms.
• Maintain clean, structured and queryable datasets.
• Evaluate AI responses for citations, recommendations, position, sentiment and factual accuracy against competitors.
• Apply statistical methods to assess variance, sample sizes, confidence ranges and model changes.
• Track AI-driven traffic, conversions and revenue using GA4 and BigQuery.
• Measure the impact of AEO/GEO and structured data improvements through controlled comparisons where possible.
• Analyse relationships between AI search, paid search and organic search.
• Build and maintain Looker Studio dashboards for marketing and retail stakeholders.
• Deliver weekly performance summaries and actionable recommendations.
• Produce focused reports for Black Friday and major product launches.
• Identify inaccuracies in AI-generated information about pricing, delivery, price matching and reviews.
• Collaborate with analytics, paid search, trading and marketing teams.
## Requirements
• 3+ years of experience in digital, marketing or ecommerce analytics.
• Strong Python and SQL skills, including API scripting and automated data collection.
• Experience with GA4, BigQuery and Looker Studio, or an equivalent analytics stack.
• Confident Excel skills.
• Solid understanding of statistics, including sampling, variance, significance and limitations of observational data.
• Experience with, or a clear interest in, LLM APIs and evaluating model outputs.
• Understanding of SEO or paid search data and its relationship with revenue.
• Ability to independently build and maintain data pipelines.
• Ability to analyse complex, changing datasets and communicate clear, evidence-based insights to senior stakeholders.
• Strong analytical rigour and the ability to explain findings to non-technical audiences.
• A sceptical, evidence-led mindset with the confidence to challenge weak attribution assumptions.
## Nice to Have
• Hands-on experience with AI visibility platforms such as Profound, Peec AI, Ahrefs Brand Radar or Semrush's AI toolkit.
• Experience with LLM evaluation methods, including automated scoring of model responses.
• Experience working in retail businesses with significant seasonal demand peaks.
• Background in consumer electricals or high-consideration retail.
• Experience with experiment design or causal inference in marketing.

By bridging science, and real-world commercialization, Molecule aims to make scientific research more transparent, accessible, collaborative, and economically sustainable.
## The Role
You will be an AI Scientist at Molecule. In your first four weeks, you will live on-site, embedded with the founding team, and ship your first autonomous agent fleet into production against a real disease area. From day one you own the loop: design the agents, deploy them, pilot them, iterate, and generate scientific output that moves IP forward.
This is not a research role with a roadmap handed to you. You will pick targets, stand up infrastructure, recruit your sub-agents, and prove that autonomous science works at the bench-to-IP level. After the residency, you scale: more fleets, more disease areas, more shots on goal.
## What You'll Do
Architect and deploy fleets of scientific agents spanning literature mining, target identification, molecular design, assay design, and data analysis
Pilot each fleet against a specific disease area and drive it to a tangible deliverable — a validated target, a candidate molecule, a novel dataset, an IP-NFT
Run multiple fleets in parallel across disease areas, reporting results directly to the CEO
Own the full stack: agent design, orchestration, evaluation, and scientific judgment on outputs
Define and set the standard for how autonomous science gets done at Molecule
## Who You Are
Entrepreneurial to the core. You ship. You don't wait for permission.
Technically deep across LLMs, agent frameworks, and at least one wet-science domain - chemistry, biology, pharma, structural biology, or genomics
Comfortable with ambiguity. You may be the only person in the room who knows how to do what you do, and that energizes you
Credential-agnostic. PhD, MSc, BSc, or straight from high school - output matters, not titles. If you hold a degree, it should be from a top-tier institution (Oxbridge, Ivy League, MIT, Caltech, Stanford, ETH/EPFL, Imperial, or equivalent). If you skipped the degree, show us what you built instead.
All-in on intensity. Willing to live on-site for 4 weeks and operate at founder pace
## What We Offer
An early seat at the company building the infrastructure for autonomous science
Direct ownership over a frontier no one else is running at
The fastest path from idea to deployed IP that exists in biotech today

title: Platform SRE
description:
About Nexcess
Nexcess provides specialty cloud solutions for organizations where performance and compliance have to coexist. We serve businesses worldwide, from agencies scaling client sites to enterprises running mission-critical operations. We've built our reputation on deep technical expertise and genuine partnership with every client we work with. Behind every environment we manage is a team of people who take the craft seriously and keep showing up when it matters.
The Platform SRE is a member of the Platform SRE team, the group responsible for the operational health, resiliency, and modernization of our hosting and cloud infrastructure. This role sits at the intersection of systems engineering, site reliability engineering, and automation : combining hands-on technical debt remediation with large-scale automation and reliability practice.
The Platform SRE team owns three core mandates:
1. Technical debt reduction : systematically identifying and remediating aging firmware, kernels, operating systems, and software across the managed hosting fleet and managed application environments.
2. Automation of critical operational workflows : provisioning, patching, remediation, and release processes across both managed apps and managed hosting fleets, with automated release planning and execution under human supervision (not “automation for automation’s sake,” but automation with a human checkpoint before production impact).
3. Reliability and incident support : defining, instrumenting, and tracking SLIs/SLOs for platform engineering and operations, visualized through dashboards and reporting tools, and providing fast, expert frontline response and remediation during service-impacting events (incident command and process ownership sit with the Incident Management team; this team is the technical responder, not the incident owner).
This position serves as a senior technical point of contact for platform engineering, driving initiatives around scalability, fault tolerance, automation, and operational excellence across production infrastructure.
Key Responsibilities
Technical Debt & Platform Modernization
• Own the lifecycle of firmware, kernel, OS, and software patching across the managed hosting fleet and managed application environments
• Build a standing inventory and risk model of technical debt (end-of-life OS versions, unpatched firmware, deprecated software) and drive prioritized remediation plans
• Evaluate and implement infrastructure modernization initiatives, replacing manual or legacy processes with supportable, automated alternatives
Automation & Release Engineering
• Design and build automation for provisioning, deployment, patching, remediation, and configuration management across managed apps and managed hosting fleets
• Own the design of automated release pipelines : planning, staging, and executing releases with defined human-in-the-loop approval gates
• Develop self-healing and auto-remediation capability for common failure modes to reduce manual operational load
• Support and extend CI/CD workflows and infrastructure-as-code practices across the platform
Reliability Engineering, SLIs/SLOs & Observability
• Define SLIs and SLOs for platform engineering and operations in partnership with engineering and product stakeholders
• Instrument systems to measure SLIs accurately and build SLO tracking into standard reporting
• Build and maintain dashboards (e.g., Grafana, Datadog, or equivalent visualization tooling) to make SLI/SLO performance, error budgets, and platform health visible to engineering and leadership
• Continuously improve platform observability : monitoring, alerting, logging, and tracing : across distributed and containerized environments
Incident Response & Remediation (Support Role)
• Serve as the frontline technical responder: acknowledge pages quickly, diagnose, and remediate platform-level issues
• Partner with the Incident Management team, who own incident command, severity classification, and customer communication : this role provides the technical hands and expertise, not incident ownership
• Contribute technical findings to blameless root cause analysis (RCA) and own follow-through on corrective actions for platform systems
• Maintain runbooks and on-call readiness for platform and infrastructure systems
• Track incident trends on platform systems and feed them back into the technical debt and automation roadmap
Collaboration & Technical Leadership
• Partner with software engineering teams on platform architecture, operational readiness reviews, and scalability initiatives
• Support platform security, compliance, and operational governance requirements
• Mentor engineers and contribute to technical leadership and knowledge-sharing across the team
• Maintain clear operational documentation and contribute to team standards and process improvement
## ● Other duties as assigned
Requirements
• 3–5+ years of experience in platform engineering, systems engineering, SRE, or infrastructure operations (level based on experience and scope)
• Advanced Linux systems administration and troubleshooting expertise, including kernel and firmware-level familiarity
• Strong experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and container orchestration/distributed systems
• Hands-on automation and infrastructure-as-code experience (e.g., Terraform, Ansible, Puppet/Chef, or equivalent)
• Experience building or maintaining CI/CD and automated release/deployment pipelines
• Experience defining and tracking SLIs/SLOs and working with observability/visualization tools (e.g., Grafana, Datadog, Prometheus, or equivalent)
• Experience supporting enterprise-scale, high-concurrency, or customer-impacting production environments
• Demonstrated experience as a technical responder in production incidents, including root cause analysis and corrective action follow-through
• Strong scripting ability (e.g., Python, Bash, Go) for automation and tooling
• Strong troubleshooting skills across compute, network, storage, and application layers
• Experience supporting cloud-hosted, managed hosting, or hybrid infrastructure environments
• Ability to lead technical initiatives, mentor others, and communicate clearly across teams
Preferred Qualifications
• Experience owning fleet-wide firmware/OS patch management programs at scale
• Experience designing human-in-the-loop release automation or progressive delivery systems (canary, blue/green)
• Familiarity with error budgets and SLO-driven prioritization frameworks
• Experience with configuration/patch management at scale across heterogeneous hardware fleets

• Organize and coordinate small to medium-sized security projects, develop basic project plans based on requirements analysis, and communicate project status to leadership and management, including accomplishments, challenges, impediments, and key metrics.
• Stay current on cloud security trends and best practices to support the ongoing improvement of CSG's public cloud security framework.
• Serve as a subject matter expert in public cloud security, consulting with team members and stakeholders across the organization to provide guidance and help resolve basic to moderately complex cloud security challenges.
• Analyze, assess, develop, implement, troubleshoot, and maintain basic to moderately complex commercial, cloud-native, and open-source security solutions.
• Work outside normal business hours as needed to diagnose issues and implement product releases or changes without disrupting normal business operations.
Is this opportunity right for you? We are looking for candidates who have:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, a related field, or equivalent experience.
• 2+ years of experience working extensively in information security or highly technical IT fields.

Familiarity with major application-layer protocols, including HTTP, HTTPS, FTP, SFTP, FTPS, SMTP, and DNS. Ability to read and understand packet traces and interpret network access control lists.
• Understanding of network and application attacks, including DoS/DDoS, buffer overflows, SQL injection, reconnaissance scanning, and techniques attackers use to evade detection. Familiarity with well-known vulnerabilities and exploits.
• Working knowledge of IT security, compliance, and regulatory requirements, such as Payment Card Industry (PCI) Data Security Standard (DSS), Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX), Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA), and state and federal privacy laws.

title: AI Solutions Engineer
description:
The Role: We are looking for an engineer who builds real solutions to real business problems. You will sit with teams across YA Group, learn how their work gets done, find where AI and automation can make it faster, more accurate or less manual, and then build those solutions yourself. This is an internal, hands-on role. You are not selling products or running demos for customers. You will design, build and ship working tools that our people use every day, using modern AI development tools such as Claude Code alongside solid engineering practice. You will be the first dedicated AI and automation hire on the team, reporting directly to the Head of Technology & Transformation. You will help shape how YA Group uses AI from the ground up. This is a fully remote role open to candidates located anywhere in the United States.
## In This Role, You Will:
## Understand the business
Spend time with the business to map how work flows today, including the manual steps, handoffs and workarounds. Identify and size opportunities for AI and automation, and help prioritize them by business value and effort. Translate business needs into clear, practical solution designs that non-technical stakeholders can understand and approve.
## Build and ship
Design, build, test and deploy AI-enabled tools, agents, workflow automations and integrations. Use AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code and similar) to move fast, while owning the quality, security and maintainability of what ships. Integrate with our core business systems, including Microsoft 365, Salesforce, NetSuite and Dayforce, through APIs and connectors. Work with our data platform and data owners to get the data your solutions need, in a governed way.
## Architecture and enablement
Contribute to reference architectures and reusable patterns for AI solutions: approved tools, connectors, environments, and how solutions access data. Support builders outside IT, including AI specialists in other departments, with standards, code review and guidance so their work is secure and maintainable. Maintain an inventory of AI solutions across the company: what exists, who owns it and what data it uses.
## Run and improve
Support what you build after launch: monitoring, fixes, documentation and handoff where appropriate. Measure outcomes such as hours saved, error reduction and cycle time, and report them in plain terms. Help triage and manage the queue of AI requests from across the business. Partner with Information Security to put our AI governance framework into practice: tool and vendor evaluation, data access controls, review before production, and lifecycle ownership.
## What You Bring:
## Required
Hands-on development experience: 3+ years building and shipping software that real users depended on, not only prototypes or personal projects. Strong programming skills in Python and/or TypeScript/JavaScript, with experience in REST APIs, JSON and SQL. Integration experience: connecting business systems through APIs, webhooks or integration platforms. Engineering fundamentals: version control (Git), testing, deployment, logging and error handling. Security awareness: sound handling of credentials, access permissions and sensitive data. Practical AI experience: has built real solutions with large language models (prompting, tool use, retrieval or agents) and uses AI coding tools in daily work, with the judgment to know when to rely on them and when to step in. Solution design: experience designing the architecture of the solutions you build, not only building to someone else's design. AI risk awareness: working knowledge of risks such as data leakage, prompt injection and model limitations, and the governance practices that address them. Business process skills: able to sit with business users, ask good questions, map a workflow and explain technical options in plain language. Ownership: comfortable working independently, managing your own priorities and seeing work through to adoption.
## Preferred
Experience with Microsoft 365 / Microsoft Graph, Salesforce, NetSuite or Dayforce. Experience with the Claude API, Model Context Protocol (MCP) or agent frameworks. Cloud experience (Azure preferred) and familiarity with data warehouses and pipelines. Background in professional services, engineering or another field-based business. Experience working in a SOC 2 or similarly controlled environment.
## Why Join:
Build a new capability at a company that is serious about using AI to improve how work gets done. Direct access to leadership and a wide view across the business. Visible impact: your work will be used across the company, not shelved. Remote role with a modern toolset.
## Who We Are:
YA Group is an international professional services organization providing forensic consulting, engineering, risk mitigation, and related services. Founded over 25 years ago as a property damage consulting firm, YA has expanded through organic growth and strategic acquisitions. Today, YA has over 800 professionals dedicated to excellence, partnership, and driving innovation.
## What We Offer:
Employee-focused culture Strong commitment to work-life balance Remote work Flexible vacation & Paid holidays Paid family care and sick leave Parental leave Comprehensive benefits 401k with company match
## Fraudulent Recruitment Alert:
Please be vigilant against fraudulent recruitment attempts. YA will never ask for personal financial information, such as bank account numbers or identification numbers, via social media or chat-based apps. YA also will not request money for the purchase of business equipment, post job opportunities on Craigslist, or conduct interviews solely via text message. All official email communications regarding applications will come from or directly from a member of YA’s talent team using an @yagroup.com domain name. If fraudulent activity is suspected, please contact .
## Disclosures:
As part of our recruitment process, we may use AI-assisted tools to support candidate screening and evaluation. These tools are designed to assist, rather than replace, human decision-making, and all employment decisions are made by our recruiting team in accordance with applicable laws and our commitment to equal employment opportunity. Where required by law, we will provide additional information about the use of these tools, including their purpose, and offer alternative processes or accommodations upon request.

Quartermaster is building the world’s most comprehensive maritime intelligence platform. Our SmartMast™ system transforms commercial and civilian vessels into a persistent, distributed sensing network—combining HD video, AI, radar, RF sensing, and AIS to deliver real-time maritime domain awareness at global scale. We’re looking for a Full Stack Software Engineer to help build the Quartermaster product, the operator-facing application that defense analysts, coast guard operators, and commercial fleet managers use to monitor, query, and act on maritime intelligence in real time. You’ll ship features across our React frontend and Spring backend, working closely with senior engineers, design, and our operations team. This role is a great fit for a strong engineer who wants to grow into larger ownership while deepening their skills in geospatial systems, real-time data, and distributed services.

Build and ship full-stack features across our React web portal and Spring Boot backend services, owning them from implementation through release.

Write and tune PostGIS queries that support map rendering, bulk artifact retrieval, and time-series analysis.
Build internal admin and fleet management tools that help our operations team configure, monitor, and support deployed SmartMast units.

title: GTM DevOps Engineer
description:
At ClickUp, we're building the future of work: the first truly converged AI workspace unifying tasks, docs, chat, calendar, and enterprise search, all supercharged by context-driven AI. We are an AI-native company. Every team member is expected to leverage AI daily, and we evaluate AI fluency as part of our hiring process. Join us and help redefine what's possible. 🚀
## Job Summary
We are looking for a GTM DevOps Engineer to join our Business Systems team and own the reliability, automation, and delivery infrastructure behind our Go-To-Market (GTM) technology stack. This role sits at the intersection of platform reliability and CI/CD engineering, ensuring that our critical business systems — including Salesforce, NetSuite, MuleSoft, Workato, and an expanding portfolio of AI-powered workloads — are deployed consistently, operate resiliently, and scale with the business.
You will partner closely with Business Systems developers, architects, and business stakeholders to build and maintain the pipelines, monitoring frameworks, and operational standards that keep our GTM systems healthy and our release cycles fast and predictable. As our team builds and deploys AI agents across GCP Cloud Run and AWS Bedrock AgentCore, you will serve as the infrastructure and deployment owner for these workloads — bringing engineering discipline to an environment where AI-generated code is increasingly entering production. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who thrives in complexity, takes ownership of platform uptime, and brings a software engineering mindset to business application operations — directly supporting GTMSOE's broader mission of operational excellence across the GTM org.
## Key Responsibilities
## CI/CD & Release Engineering
Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines for Salesforce (SFDX/Salesforce CLI), NetSuite (SuiteScript/SuiteBundler), MuleSoft (Anypoint Platform), and Workato; establish branching strategies, environment promotion standards, and release gating processes across all GTM platforms.
Extend CI/CD practices to cover AI agent workloads deployed on GCP Cloud Run and AWS Bedrock AgentCore — including containerized builds, deployment pipelines, and automated validation gates.
Implement safe rollout patterns — including feature toggles, phased launches, automated validation, smoke tests, and rollback procedures — to reduce deployment risk on business-critical changes.
## Platform Reliability & Observability
Own SLA/SLO definitions for core GTM systems; standardize monitoring, alerting, and runbook patterns across quote-to-cash and GTM integrations, with proactive health checks and synthetic monitoring for critical flows (e.g., Salesforce ↔ NetSuite, Workato).
Extend observability coverage to GCP Cloud Run workloads — Cloud Scheduler jobs, agent pipelines, and integration microservices — and AWS-hosted agent infrastructure.
Conduct root cause analysis (RCA) for platform incidents and drive post-incident reviews with actionable remediation plans.
## Cloud Infrastructure & Environment Management
Manage sandbox, staging, and production environment lifecycles across GTM platforms — including refresh cycles, data masking, environment segmentation, and promotion standards that balance speed with reliability.
Own cloud infrastructure for Business Systems-operated workloads on GCP (Cloud Run, Cloud Scheduler, Cloud Secret Manager, GCS, Artifact Registry) and AWS (Lambda, S3, EventBridge, Secrets Manager, Bedrock AgentCore); apply IaC practices to make provisioning repeatable and auditable.
Establish base image pinning, dependency vulnerability scanning, and supply chain security practices for containerized workloads — particularly AI-generated codebases deployed via tools like Cursor or Claude Code.
Define and enforce patch management and container runtime ownership for vibe-coded and agentic workloads entering production.
## Secrets, Access & Security Posture
Establish and enforce a consistent secrets management standard across all Business Systems workloads — GCP Secret Manager, AWS Secrets Manager, and equivalent — eliminating credential exposure via environment variables, source code, or client-side contexts.
Define and maintain API key rotation policies in alignment with security standards (high-severity keys: quarterly; vendor keys: annually at minimum).
Partner with Security and IT on IAM scoping, least-privilege service accounts, VPC configuration, and public/private endpoint governance for Cloud Run and Bedrock deployments.
Maintain a centralized registry of deployed workloads — GitHub repos, deployment URLs, architecture docs, data classification, and observability dashboard links — accessible to AppSec and infrastructure teams.
## Automation & Tooling
Build internal tooling, automation scripts, and automated testing frameworks (unit, integration, regression) to reduce toil and increase deployment confidence; continuously evaluate new tooling to improve developer experience.
Develop or enforce GitHub repository templates for Cloud Run deployments that cover security audits, deployment configuration, API integration, and MCP server patterns — serving as a reusable foundation for AI-assisted builds.
## Governance, Standards & Collaboration
Define where self-service deployment and administration are appropriate versus where stronger change control and operational guardrails are required; serve as the DevOps SME, enabling developers to operate with autonomy within those boundaries.
Document and maintain operational runbooks, architecture decision records (ADRs), and deployment standards as living artifacts.
Collaborate with IT, Data Engineering, Security, and business stakeholders on cross-functional initiatives that touch the GTM platform.
## Qualifications
## Experience
4+ years in a DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or Platform Engineering role
2+ years of hands-on experience deploying and managing Salesforce environments (SFDX, Salesforce CLI, scratch orgs, sandboxes, change sets, or pipeline-based deployments)
Experience with at least one additional GTM/ERP platform, such as NetSuite, MuleSoft, or Workato, in an operational or deployment capacity
Demonstrated experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or Copado
Hands-on experience with GCP services — Cloud Run, Cloud Scheduler, Cloud Secret Manager, Artifact Registry, GCS — in a deployment or operations context
Experience with AWS services in an integration or operations context — Lambda, S3, SQS, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch; familiarity with Bedrock AgentCore or similar managed agent hosting infrastructure is a strong plus
Experience managing containerized workloads, including image lifecycle, dependency scanning, and supply chain security practices
Experience with incident management, on-call processes, and writing post-incident reviews
## Skills & Competencies
Technical
Strong scripting skills in Python, Bash, or Node.js for automation and tooling
Proficiency with Git, branching strategies, and version control best practices
Understanding of API-based integration patterns (REST, SOAP, event-driven) as they apply to MuleSoft, Workato, or similar iPaaS tools
Hands-on familiarity with secrets management across GCP Secret Manager and AWS Secrets Manager; strong grasp of security best practices in CI/CD contexts (least-privilege IAM, no hardcoded credentials, key rotation)
Monitoring and observability tooling experience (Datadog, Splunk, Google Cloud Monitoring, CloudWatch, or similar)
Infrastructure-as-code proficiency — Terraform or CloudFormation; experience applying IaC to Cloud Run or Lambda-based workloads preferred
Familiarity with container security practices: base image pinning, vulnerability scanning (e.g., Artifact Registry, Trivy), and dependency management for AI-generated codebases
Operational & Mindset
Ownership: Takes full accountability for platform uptime, deployment quality, and the operational health of GTM infrastructure end-to-end.
Velocity: Operates with a bias for action — ships iteratively, reduces toil systematically, and keeps release cycles fast and predictable.
AI & Automation mindset: Actively leverages AI-assisted tooling and automation to accelerate delivery, improve reliability, and reduce manual overhead across the GTM stack.
Collaboration: Fluent cross-functional partner to developers, architects, Security, IT, and business stakeholders — enables autonomy without becoming a bottleneck.
Growth: Continuously evaluates new tooling, patterns, and practices to raise the bar on platform engineering and developer experience.
## What You'll Work With
Salesforce: Core GTM CRM platform; this role owns deployment pipelines, environment management, and release reliability across orgs.
NetSuite: ERP platform integrated into the quote-to-cash flow; managed via SuiteScript/SuiteBundler within CI/CD standards.

GCP (Cloud Run, Cloud Scheduler, Secret Manager, Artifact Registry, GCS): Primary cloud platform for AI agent workloads and integration microservices.
AWS (Lambda, S3, EventBridge, Secrets Manager, Bedrock AgentCore): Secondary cloud environment for agent hosting and integration operations.
GitHub Actions / GitLab CI / Copado: CI/CD tooling used to build, validate, and promote changes across GTM platforms.
Terraform / CloudFormation: IaC tooling for repeatable, auditable infrastructure provisioning.
Datadog / Splunk / Google Cloud Monitoring / CloudWatch: Observability and alerting stack across GTM and cloud workloads.

title: Full-Stack Growth Engineer
description:
About Us:
Future is building a personalized guidance system for lifelong health. We help people understand what to do next for their body, goals, and stage of life — then support them in turning those decisions into sustained behavior change. By combining AI, human expertise, personal health data, and accountability, Future helps members improve performance today while building the resilience, capacity, and healthspan they need for decades to come.
## About the Role:
We’re hiring a Full-Stack Growth Engineer to build and maintain the product and systems that help more of the right people discover Future, convert into members, and reach their first moments of value.
You’ll work across web and backend surfaces that power acquisition, signup and access, onboarding and activation, and early engagement. You’ll ship experiments end to end, instrument funnels carefully, and partner closely with product, design, data, and marketing on a small, senior team.
This is a hands-on role. You’ll move between product judgment and system design, write production code, run trustworthy experiments, and turn learnings into durable product improvements — not one-off hacks.
## What You’ll Own:
• Acquisition and Conversion: Build and improve the web and product surfaces that introduce Future to prospective members and turn interest into signup. These include landing experiences, checkout and plan selection flows, and the instrumentation that shows where people drop off.
• Access and Onboarding: Simplify signup, login, account creation, and first-session activation. Remove friction, clarify value on Day 1, and help new members connect with coaching and get started quickly.
• Experimentation Systems: Design, ship, and analyze A/B and multivariate tests across the funnel. Partner with data to define metrics, guardrails, and experiment hygiene so we learn fast without polluting the product.
• Full-Stack Delivery: Implement features across frontend and backend — APIs, services, web UI, and the glue between growth surfaces and the core member product. Prefer clear ownership and fast iteration over brittle one-off paths.
• Measurement and Insight: Instrument funnels, cohorts, and activation milestones. Use qualitative and quantitative signal to find leverage, prioritize work, and explain why experiments won or lost.
• Reliability for Growth Paths: Keep high-traffic growth journeys fast, stable, and observable. Treat conversion-critical paths with the same engineering care as core product.
• Cross-Functional Partnership: Work tightly with product, design, data, and marketing. Translate growth hypotheses into shippable product work and bring engineering judgment into roadmap tradeoffs.
• AI-Assisted Development: Use coding agents and AI tools to speed up exploration, implementation, testing, and review. Apply engineering judgment to validate their output before it reaches members or prospects.
## Who You Are:
## Experience and Background
• You have 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, including meaningful ownership of consumer growth, acquisition, activation, or conversion surfaces.
• You are strong full-stack: comfortable across modern web frontend and backend services, and able to ship an experiment from UI through API and data without waiting on another team for every layer.
• You have run growth experiments in production — A/B tests, funnel instrumentation, and iteration based on measured outcomes, not vibes alone.
• You understand customer journeys: segments, touchpoints, dropoff analysis, and how product changes move activation and retention metrics.
• You can debug across web UI, networking, backend services, analytics pipelines, and CI.
• You have partnered with product, design, and data (or marketing) to take ambiguous growth problems from hypothesis to shipped learning.
• You write clear, maintainable code and care about experiment integrity, observability, and long-term operability — not just shipping the next test.
• You use AI coding tools in your development workflow and know how to verify their output.
## Domain Passion
You care about health, fitness, and helping people start — and stick with — better habits. You’re motivated by the craft of turning curiosity into membership and first value.
## Working Style
• You bias to action, then measure. You ship small, learn, and compound.
• You raise concerns early and bring possible solutions when experiments or funnels look wrong.
• You share context, invite feedback, and keep partners aligned on metrics and tradeoffs.
• You take ownership from discovery through production support on the paths you ship.
• You balance growth urgency with product quality and member trust.
## Nice to Have
• Experience at a consumer subscription, marketplace, or membership product where acquisition and activation were core to the business.
• Familiarity with HIPAA and other laws and regulations that apply to health products and services.
• Experience with paid acquisition landing systems, attribution, SEO/organic surfaces, lifecycle messaging, or referral loops.
• Experience building or evolving experimentation platforms, feature flags, or analytics instrumentation at scale.
• Experience with fitness, health, coaching, or other personalized consumer products.
• Prior work on expert tooling, internal operator workflows, or coach-facing surfaces that support member outcomes.
## Compensation, Benefits & Life at Future:
• Salary range: $200,000 - 230,000 / year + equity. The salary range is set based on multiple considerations including business needs, market demands, talent availability, experience, and unique skills and attributes. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future.
• Health coverage: All employees have access to comprehensive medical, vision, dental, and disability insurance + tax savings accounts
• 401(k) plan
• Flexible Paid Time Off
• Future Membership: Enjoy our platform for free!
• Health, Wellness & Development: Health and fitness monthly stipend contributes to our employees’ overall wellbeing, with access to a mental health platform, reimbursement for medical travel, and an annual learning & development stipend.
• Remote First: Employment eligible to employees located anywhere in the continental US. No travel required.
• Join a diverse, passionate & driven team of all backgrounds.
## Life at Future
Equity: Meaningful equity package.
Health Coverage: All employees who meet eligibility requirements receive comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and disability insurance, plus tax-advantaged savings accounts.
Retirement: 401(k) plan.
Wellness: Monthly wellness stipend for fitness, recovery, and overall wellbeing, plus access to mental health resources and therapy support.
Flexible Time Off: Flexible PTO so you can rest, recharge, and take care of life outside of work.
Learning & Development: Annual budget for courses, conferences, coaching, and tools that help you grow in your craft.
Future Membership: Enjoy our platform for free.
## Equal Employment Opportunities at Future
We are committed to building a future where every member of our community, is healthy, cared for, and advancing forward together. Future is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, age, civil or family status, disability or race.

Herzstück ist unsere KI-gestützte Plattform Enpal.One+, die tausende Systeme intelligent vernetzt und Strombezug sowie -einspeisung effizient am Energiemarkt optimiert.
Omniwatt Energy ist die Strom-Unit von Enpal und macht saubere Energie für jeden Haushalt zugänglich – vom günstigsten Stromtarif Deutschlands bis hin zu intelligenten Energielösungen, die Erzeugung, Speicherung und Verbrauch optimal vernetzen.
Mit ambitionierten Wachstumszielen und einem schnell wachsenden Kundenstamm bauen wir ein Team, das den deutschen Energiemarkt aktiv mitgestaltet. Dabei verbinden wir Startup-Geschwindigkeit mit der Skalierung eines Marktführers – über alle Bereiche hinweg, von Operations und Technologie über Finance und Customer Support bis hin zu Produktentwicklung.
## Deine Aufgaben
Du willst nicht nur Konzepte entwickeln, sondern Lösungen selbst bauen?
Bei Omniwatt bauen wir konsequent neue Geschäftsbereiche aus und entwickeln bestehende Bereiche weiter. title: Stage 2027 - IA/ML Engineer 50% R&D 50% Produit - Statistiques Bayésiennes
description:
Ekimetrics est un leader mondial de l'efficacité marketing et commerciale et des solutions d'IA à l'échelle. Depuis 2006, nous aidons les entreprises à optimiser leur marketing et leurs opérations en combinant IA avec expertise business et technologique dans 4 domaines : Marketing & commercial effectiveness, Customer analytics, Operational excellence, ESG & sustainability.
Avec une équipe 100% internalisée et des bureaux à Paris, Londres, New York, Hong Kong et Shanghai, nous concevons des solutions sur mesure qui transforment les données en impact positif concret, grâce à une combinaison unique de technologie et de services.
Notre force est de déployer une IA à impact, à grande échelle. Notre mission : mobiliser cette puissance pour répondre aux défis les plus urgents de notre temps. Nous nous engageons pour une IA responsable et frugale, pour garantir un impact constant à grande échelle, et pour rester fidèles à nos valeurs et à notre ADN.
Contexte
Les modèles marketing sont mis à jour à mesure que de nouvelles données arrivent : ventes hebdomadaires, résultats de campagnes, comportement des clients. Ils comprennent les marketing mix models (MMM), qui estiment le retour sur investissement de chaque canal média, ainsi que les modèles de demande et de promotion et les modèles de réponse client. Chaque mise à jour fait bouger les estimations, et la première question des métiers est : pourquoi ont-elles bougé ?
Notre équipe a développé une méthode qui y répond de façon exacte pour les modèles bayésiens. Elle répartit le déplacement de toute quantité a posteriori entre des groupes d'observations : semaines, campagnes, régions, segments de clients ou expériences. La méthode est en cours d'évaluation par les pairs. Un premier prototype sur le MMM suit déjà une estimation semaine après semaine et lève une alerte quand une mise à jour la déplace plus que prévu.
Sujet : pourquoi l'estimation a-t-elle bougé ? Attribution bayésienne en ligne pour les modèles marketing.
Volet recherche (environ 3 mois)
• Étendre l'attribution à l'apprentissage bayésien en ligne : mises à jour séquentielles, effets variables dans le temps (modèles linéaires dynamiques, filtre de Kalman), oubli des données anciennes.
• Distinguer les trois causes d'un déplacement à chaque mise à jour : les nouvelles données, un vrai changement du marché et une erreur dans un flux de données.
• Calibrer l'alerte de mise à jour : taux de fausses alertes et délai de détection, sur des données simulées dont la vérité est connue et sur des données publiques, pour le MMM et pour au moins un autre modèle marketing.
• Rédiger un article destiné à un public de statistique ou de marketing science.
Volet produit (environ 3 mois)
• Transformer la méthode en un module Python testé, compatible avec nos outils de modélisation bayésienne (le MMM en premier).
• Construire les sorties destinées aux métiers : une vue « ce qui a fait bouger l'estimation » et une alerte de mise à jour.
• Les valider avec des consultants sur des cas réels, puis les documenter et les transmettre à l'équipe produit.
Livrables attendus
• Un article soumis à une revue ou une conférence à comité de lecture.
• Un module Python testé et documenté, intégré à nos outils de modélisation.
• Un guide court pour les consultants : comment lire et expliquer une attribution.
Profil
• Étudiant ou étudiante en dernière année de master ou d'école d'ingénieurs, en statistique, science des données ou probabilités.
• Statistique bayésienne (prior, posterior, MCMC), et idéalement séries temporelles ou modèles à espace d'états.
• Bonne maîtrise de Python (NumPy, une librairie de programmation probabiliste comme PyMC ou NumPyro), Git, tests unitaires.
• Intérêt pour l'application de la statistique au marketing et pour l'explication des résultats à des non-spécialistes. Aucune connaissance préalable en marketing n'est requise. Rédaction claire en anglais.
Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?
Chez Ekimetrics, vos idées comptent vraiment et vous appartiennent — à vous de leur donner vie. Nous cultivons un esprit entrepreneurial qui vous encourage à repousser les limites pour créer un impact significatif.
Mais il ne s’agit pas seulement de réussites individuelles : nous avançons ensemble, en nous enrichissant mutuellement. Ensemble, nous apprenons et progressons en continu, que ce soit à travers des parcours de carrière personnalisés, des projets stimulants, du mentorat, ou simplement grâce à la diversité des perspectives que chacun.e apporte.
Et surtout, nous croyons au plaisir dans le travail. Ekimetrics est un environnement stimulant et bienveillant, où chacun.e peut s’épanouir en étant pleinement soi-même.
En 2023, Ekimetrics a obtenu le statut d’entreprise à mission qui témoigne de notre ambition forte en matière de RSE. Notre raison d’être : Faire de la data science et de l’intelligence artificielle l’accélérateur de la transformation durable des organisations.
Nous sommes également certifiés Great Place to Work© en France, au Royaume-Uni et aux Etats-Unis, et notre bureau de Hong Kong a reçu le prix Best Companies to Work for in Asia 2023©.
Ekimetrics fait partie du classement French Tech 120 !Nous avons été sélectionnés par La French Tech pour rejoindre le prestigieux groupe des 120 scale-ups françaises les plus performantes, avec un fort potentiel pour devenir des leaders internationaux.
Vous aurez accès :

title: Intern AI Researcher: Anomaly Detection for Predictive Maintenance in Distributed Storage
description:
## About Scality
Scality builds data infrastructure software for enterprise AI, cyber resilience, and sovereign control at multi-petabyte to exabyte scale. Its AI Data Infrastructure platform reduces operational burden through AI-powered autonomous operations while aligning the right storage media, performance, and protection to each workload through human-approved lifecycle policies.
Built on CORE5 cyber resilience and open-code principles, Scality software delivers extreme performance, operational simplicity, and sustainable economics.
The world's most demanding enterprises and government organizations depend on Scality to power AI initiatives, defend critical data, and build infrastructure that lasts for decades. Recognized as a leader by Gartner, Scality is where AI remembers, learns, and thinks. F
Follow us on LinkedIn. Visit www.scality.com and our blog.
Context & Motivation
A distributed storage cluster continuously emits telemetry at every level, from the platform and S3 service down to each server and disk. A failing disk, server or storage node leaves traces in these multivariate time series, from subtle shifts in a few metrics to system-wide disruption. Detecting and diagnosing these anomalies early is critical for:
• Predictive maintenance: isolating or replacing a component before it impacts service
• Faster diagnosis: pointing support engineers to the root cause, not just to an alert
• Higher availability and durability of customer data
This internship is part of a joint research project between Scality and an INRIA research team. The project released SHAD (Scality High-dimensional Anomaly Detection), an open benchmark published at NeurIPS 2026 (Evaluations & Datasets Track). It contains 215 real 171-dimensional time series from Scality RING clusters, annotated for injected disk, server and storage-node failures. SHAD's baselines show the problem is far from solved. No detector handles every failure type, per-dimension attributions find root causes no better than chance, and off-the-shelf LLMs cannot interpret the anomalies. This internship builds on SHAD to close these gaps.
More details on the project: scality.github.io/shad
Your Mission
As part of our R&D team and in close collaboration with INRIA researchers, you will develop AI models that detect, explain and interpret anomalies in storage-cluster telemetry. Your work will include:
1. State of the Art
Review the literature and open-source projects on multivariate time series anomaly detection, root-cause attribution and LLM-based interpretation of time series. Also survey recent work on AI agents that automate research and experimentation. Starting points include SHAD and the TSB-AD benchmark.
2. Anomaly Detection & Diagnosis Models
Design, train and benchmark models that improve on SHAD's baselines at each stage of the pipeline:
• Detection that stays accurate across disk, server and storage-node failures (e.g., ensembles, hybrid models, time series foundation models)
• Explanation: attributing each anomaly to the dimensions that actually cause it
• Interpretation: turning detections into actionable diagnoses (failure type, criticality, affected component)
• Early detection of progressive degradations, the core of predictive maintenance
3. Fleets of AI Agents for Research
Set up and manage fleets of AI agents that run your studies at scale:
• Design agent workflows that launch experiments, run benchmarks and compare methods
• Orchestrate and monitor many agents working in parallel
• Build safeguards for rigor: experiment tracking, reproducibility, independent verification of results
• Assess what agent-driven research changes in practice: speed, coverage, failure modes
4. Evaluation & Validation
Evaluate every model with rigorous, reproducible protocols. Use them to:
• Measure each stage with SHAD's metrics (VUS-PR for detection, NDCG for explanation, a questionnaire for interpretation)
Quantify performance per failure family and scenario
• Identify which approaches are ready to transfer to production monitoring
Expected Outcomes & Valorization
Depending on results, the work may be valorized through:
• A scientific publication with the Scality and INRIA researchers
• New methods and baselines contributed to the open-source SHAD benchmark
• Reusable agent-based research workflows for the R&D team
Technical Stack
• Python (primary language for modeling, experimentation and analysis)
• PyTorch and scikit-learn (deep learning and classical models)
• SHAD benchmark (github.com/scality/shad) and TSB-AD (github.com/TheDatumOrg/TSB-AD) for data, detectors and evaluation
• LLM-based AI agents and their orchestration tooling
Candidate Profile
• Final-year student in a Master's program or Engineering school (Bac+5), in machine learning, data science or computer science
• Solid foundations in machine learning; experience with time series or anomaly detection is a strong plus
• Strong interest in LLMs and AI agents, and curiosity for new ways of doing research
• Good Python skills and hands-on experience with a deep learning framework such as PyTorch
• Rigorous and critical with experimental results, especially when agents produce them
• Autonomous and curious, able to communicate results clearly in written and spoken English
• Interest in distributed systems or storage is a plus, not a prerequisite
Work Environment
You will join a fast-paced, lean AI R&D team. French and English is our primary working language. You will benefit from:
• Mentorship from R&D engineers
• Close collaboration with INRIA researchers working on time series anomaly detection
• Access to real telemetry from Scality RING clusters and to the AI agent tooling the team uses for its studies
• A high-trust environment where your findings will directly influence engineering decisions
Why Join Scality?
• Work on a concrete research problem with real-world industrial impact
• Build on a benchmark published at NeurIPS and contribute to open research
• Practice a new way of doing research, with fleets of AI agents as research assistants
• Be part of a team building infrastructure trusted by Fortune 500 companies
• Potential to publish research or continue as a full-time engineer after the internship

title: Fullstack Engineer
description:
## Sobre Creai
En Creai, nos especializamos en aprovechar el poder de la inteligencia artificial y el aprendizaje automático para transformar negocios. Nuestra misión es ayudar a los clientes a reducir costos, aumentar la eficiencia y desbloquear nuevas oportunidades mediante soluciones de IA de vanguardia.
## Descripción del Puesto
Como Full Stack Software Engineer para IA, tu rol central ya no es escribir código línea por línea, sino dirigir, supervisar y validar el trabajo de agentes de IA generativa y agentica que construyen soluciones escalables y de alto impacto. Usarás tu dominio técnico y de negocio para diseñar la arquitectura correcta, definir el qué y el por qué de cada solución, delegar la ejecución táctica a la IA , y ejercer el criterio necesario para juzgar, corregir y aprobar sus outputs antes de que lleguen a producción.
Serás responsable de entregar funcionalidades completas de complejidad alta con velocidad y calidad, asegurando que la velocidad que da la IA no comprometa la estabilidad, seguridad ni mantenibilidad del sistema. Colaborarás con otros ingenieros y equipos multidisciplinarios para integrar servicios, pipelines y modelos, fortaleciendo los estándares técnicos y las prácticas de supervisión de IA dentro de Creai.
## Este Puesto Exige
Orquestación de Desarrollo: Dirigir a agentes de IA para generar funciones y servicios, revisando y refactorizando el código resultante para garantizar que sea limpio, funcional, mantenible y esté alineado con la arquitectura del sistema. Escribir código propio cuando la tarea lo requiera, especialmente en piezas críticas o ambiguas donde el criterio humano marca la diferencia.
Validación de Calidad: Diseñar la estrategia de pruebas (smoke tests, integración, end to end etc) y delegar su automatización a IA, verificando que la cobertura generada realmente valide los casos de negocio relevantes y no solo los casos evidentes.
Gestión de Datos: Definir la arquitectura de pipelines batch de datos y usar IA para acelerar su construcción, auditando personalmente la validación de schemas y la coherencia entre orígenes y destinos, dado que los errores de datos introducidos por IA suelen ser sutiles y costosos de detectar tarde.
Modelado y Entrenamiento Inicial: Supervisar el entrenamiento de modelos estándar y el ajuste de hiperparámetros —ejecutado manualmente o asistido por IA— bajo la guía del equipo de IA, evaluando de forma crítica si los resultados obtenidos responden al problema de negocio planteado.
Gestión de Incidentes: Usar IA para acelerar el triage y diagnóstico de incidentes, manteniendo la responsabilidad final de clasificar, comunicar y resolver runbooks comunes, y aportando criterio en los casos que la IA no puede resolver por sí sola.
Seguridad del Software: Usar IA para ejecutar threat checklists y sugerir parches, validando y priorizando esas recomendaciones con criterio propio antes de aplicarlas, evitando falsos positivos o negativos que la IA no puede juzgar por contexto de negocio.
Definición de Criterios de Calidad: Definir criterios de aceptación y Definition of Done para las tareas —incluyendo qué se considera un output de IA aceptable—, asegurando entregables completos, correctos y alineados al problema real de negocio, no solo funcionalmente correctos.
Diseño de Flujos con IA: Diseñar prompts, contexto y flujos de trabajo reutilizables (plantillas, snippets, agentes configurados) para copilotos e IA generativa, elevando la productividad del equipo y estableciendo buenas prácticas de uso de IA dentro de Creai.
## Requisitos
## Experiencia Técnica:
Bases sólidas en fundamentos de ingeniería de software (estructuras de datos, patrones de diseño, principios de arquitectura): son la base del criterio necesario para evaluar código y soluciones generadas por IA.
Experiencia práctica (mínimo 1–2 años) en desarrollo backend y frontend, ya sea escribiendo código directamente o dirigiendo su generación con herramientas de IA.
Experiencia usando agentes de IA (por ejemplo, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code) dentro de flujos de trabajo reales de desarrollo.
Experiencia con pipelines de CI/CD y pruebas unitarias.
Conocimientos de bases de datos relacionales y no relacionales.
Familiaridad con servicios en la nube y herramientas de control de versiones (Git).
Experiencia inicial en proyectos con aprendizaje automático o IA aplicada.
## Habilidades Profesionales:
Criterio técnico para juzgar cuándo confiar en un output de IA y cuándo cuestionarlo, corregirlo o rediseñarlo por completo.
Autonomía en la resolución de tareas de complejidad media, incluyendo la orquestación de múltiples herramientas de IA.
Colaboración efectiva dentro de equipos multidisciplinarios.
Interés en prácticas de DevSecOps y en el uso de IA para mejorar la productividad.
## Beneficios
💻 Trabajo 100% remoto con horario alineado a CST.
🏖️ PTO ilimitado: Confiamos en que gestionarás tu tiempo de manera efectiva.
🎓 Presupuesto anual para desarrollo: Acceso a cursos, certificaciones y conferencias.
🛠️ Presupuesto para equipamiento: Configura tu espacio de trabajo remoto ideal.
🩺 Beneficio de salud: Acceso a cobertura médica privada o subsidios para seguro médico.
🚀 Oportunidades de crecimiento: Plan de carrera y mentoría con expertos en IA y tecnología.
🚀 Ambiente de startup dinámico y flexible: Autonomía para tomar decisiones y proponer ideas, con un enfoque en resultados en lugar de horas trabajadas.
⚖️ Balance vida-trabajo: Cultura que prioriza la flexibilidad y el bienestar, permitiéndote gestionar tu tiempo sin sacrificar tu vida personal.
¡Te invitamos a postularte!
Incluso si no cumples con todos los requisitos, valoramos experiencias y perspectivas diversas. Si te apasiona el reclutamiento y quieres crecer en una empresa enfocada en datos e IA, ¡nos encantaría conocerte!

## JOB TITLE:
## Associate Research Scientist
## DESCRIPTION:
The Wyoming Coop Unit is seeking an Associate Research Scientist to conduct research on ungulate migrations and support regional efforts to map and characterize migration patterns across Wyoming and the American West. The position will manage and analyze GPS collar data from multiple ungulate species and study areas, identify seasonal migration dates, delineate migration corridors, and develop spatial data products to support state and federal wildlife management and conservation efforts. The position will also manage and improve databases and analytical workflows supporting regional migration assessments, including ongoing efforts across the Greater Yellowstone Area.
In addition to supporting established migration research and mapping initiatives, the Associate Research Scientist will contribute to and lead collaborative research projects that advance understanding of ungulate migration ecology and inform wildlife conservation and management across the West. This position offers an opportunity to work closely with state and federal agency partners, contribute to regional collaborative science, and translate wildlife movement data into actionable information for conservation and management.
This position provides services in collaboration with the USGS Northern Rocky Mountain Science Center (NOROCK) out of Bozeman, MT, so the successful candidate ideally would be available to work and perform essential job functions in Bozeman, MT. The selected candidate may be eligible for remote work outside of Bozeman, MT.
## ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
Research and Creative Activity:
• Manage, process, and analyze GPS collar data from multiple ungulate species and study areas to support regional efforts to identify and map ungulate migrations across Wyoming and the American West.
• Identify seasonal migration dates, delineate migration corridors, and develop spatial data products that characterize migration patterns and support wildlife conservation and management.
• Conduct spatial analyses of wildlife movement data using GIS and other analytical tools, and develop standardized workflows for processing, analyzing, and visualizing migration data.
• Contribute to regional migration assessments, including efforts to characterize ungulate migrations across the Greater Yellowstone Area.
• Develop technical reports, maps, and other scientific products, and lead or contribute to peer-reviewed publications and collaborative research projects.
• Identify opportunities for additional migration-focused research and develop analytical approaches to address emerging research and management questions.
## SUPPLEMENTAL FUNCTIONS:
Service:
• Collaborate with state and federal wildlife management agencies, university researchers, and other partners to support regional ungulate migration research and conservation initiatives.
• Respond to requests for migration data, maps, and spatial analyses from agency partners and other collaborators.
• Provide technical assistance and expertise to researchers, graduate students, and collaborators working with wildlife movement data.
• Participate in partner meetings, workshops, and collaborative research activities related to ungulate migration mapping and conservation.
• Communicate research findings and spatial data products to management agencies and other partners to support the application of migration science in wildlife management and conservation planning.
## MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:
• Education: Masters level degree
• 2 years’ experience as a field technician and spatial analyst
• Proficiency with spatial analyses in Program R
• Proficiency with modern database management and associated workflows
• Proficiency with the Migration Mapper application
## DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS:
• Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills
• Excellent skills in professional writing
• Experience with ArcMap and ArcGIS and basic mapping
• Experience working with State and Federal land management agencies
• Experience with database management and spatial analyses in R and SQL
• Experience conducting research in the Rocky Mountains area (Colorado, Wyoming, New Mexico, Montana, and Idaho)
• Knowledge of ungulate ecology and migration literature
• Experience with image processing workflows
## REQUIRED APPLICATION MATERIALS:
Complete the online application. The department additionally requests candidates upload the following document(s) for a complete application:
• Cover letter
• Resume or C.V.
• Contact information for four work-related references (references will only be contacted if you are selected as a finalist for the position).
## WORK LOCATION:
Remote/Flexible Work: This position provides services in collaboration with the USGS Northern Rocky Mountain Science Center (NOROCK), so the successful candidate ideally would be available to work and perform essential job functions in Bozeman, MT, understanding the location is around 4,820 feet above sea level. The selected candidate may be eligible for remote work outside of Bozeman, MT depending on their evaluation.
WORK AUTHORIZATION REQUIREMENTS:
The successful candidate must be eligible to work in the United States, as sponsorship for any work authorization or work visas is not available for this position.
## HIRING STATEMENT/EEO:
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. In compliance with the ADA Amendments Act (ADAAA), if you have a disability and would like to request an accommodation to apply for a position, please contact us at 307-766-2377 or email .

The University of Wyoming is located in Laramie, a charming town of 30,000 residents nestled in the heart of the Rocky Mountain West. The state of Wyoming continues to invest in its only 4-year university, helping to make it a leader in academics, research, and outreach with state-of-the-art facilities and strong community ties.
