title: Analytics Engineer 6 - Demand Science, Ads DSE
description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.
The Demand Science team within Ads Data & Insights plays a crucial role in Netflix Ads growth by equipping the business to efficiently attract, activate, and scale advertiser demand. As the lead Analytics Engineer for demand analytics, you would own the metrics, analytical roadmap, and hands-on analysis that power Netflix’s advertiser demand strategy.
If you enjoy tackling complex, open-ended analytical projects that drive product and commercial strategy and are exceptional at crafting compelling data-driven stories - this is the role for you.
## What You'll Do
As the lead Analytics Engineer for Demand Science, you'll own the vision and lead execution across areas such as:
• Own and evolve the demand analytics roadmap, prioritizing the questions that matter most to the business and successfully illuminating new opportunities for Netflix Ads through your work.
• Lead end-to-end analytical investigations into ambiguous, high-stakes demand questions — from framing the hypothesis through data development, analysis, and presentation of findings.
• Leverage your analytical findings and storytelling ability to successfully influence demand strategy at the senior leadership level across Product, Strategy, and Commercial teams.
• Guide and influence the roadmaps of other analytics engineers and data scientists in service of this learning agenda, forging strong cross-team partnerships where needed.
## Who You Are
• Experience independently scoping and leading complex and ambiguous analytical projects that have org-wide impact — not just executing on defined projects, but identifying which questions matter most and driving them from ambiguity to measurable business influence and impact.
• Strong strategic acumen and interest: You are curious about and have the ability to deeply understand business objectives (ranging from product strategy to commercial challenges) and can translate them into a prioritized analytical roadmap.
• Comfort with ambiguity and a proactive, curious approach to problem-solving — you can operate effectively in a space where the path is not laid out for you and where the "right" metric or analytical approach may not exist yet.
• You excel at synthesizing complex data into compelling, data-driven narratives that influence company strategy and business goals at the senior leadership level; you are proactive and effective at building strong cross-functional relationships.
• You may have had titles in the past like Staff/Senior Data Scientist or Staff Data Analyst.
• Proficient in SQL and a scripting language (e.g., Python); excellent at producing high-quality, impactful analysis with AI assistance, and able to lead colleagues as best practice evolves.
• Experience in ads or adtech is a bonus, but not required.
• The Netflix Culture Memo resonates with you: you hold a high bar for yourself and your colleagues, you are comfortable receiving and giving candid feedback, and you are usually responsible: self-motivated, self-aware, and self-disciplined.
Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $425,000.00 - $670,000.00. This compensation range will vary based on location.
Netflix provides comprehensive benefits including Health Plans, Mental Health support, a 401(k) Retirement Plan with employer match, Stock Option Program, Disability Programs, Health Savings and Flexible Spending Accounts, Family-forming benefits, and Life and Serious Injury Benefits. We also offer paid leave of absence programs. Full-time hourly employees accrue 35 days annually for paid time off to be used for vacation, holidays, and sick paid time off. Full-time salaried employees are immediately entitled to flexible time off. See more details about our Benefits here.
Netflix is a unique culture and environment. Learn more here.

title: Technical SEO & AI Search Specialist - Fully Remote
description:
Metricool is a social media management tool that helps freelancers, agencies, and marketing teams stay on top of their daily work. Behind every post, every campaign, and every search result sits a website that has to load fast, get indexed, and show up where it matters, and your job is to make sure ours always does.
As our Technical SEO & AI Search Specialist, you’ll report to Merche and work closely with our SEO Specialist and the rest of the team. This isn’t a role that waits for tickets to land: you’ll flag indexability issues before they turn into problems, keep our WordPress site healthy without being asked, and build the lab that explores how AI is changing search from the ground up.
You’ll work 100% remotely as part of a team that keeps Metricool’s own website fast, clean and search-ready, where good technical SEO means nothing breaks quietly and every fix holds up once real traffic hits it.
## Your day-to-day
## You’ll split your time across a few fronts:
Keep our site indexable. You’ll review indexability and clean up toxic links, so search engines can find and trust our pages.
Maintain WordPress end to end.You’ll keep our WordPress instance healthy, cleaning up outdated blocks and old images, fixing what breaks, and building new landing pages when the team needs them.
Push WPO forward. You’ll drive performance improvements so our pages stay fast as the site grows.
Manage hreflang across markets.You’ll keep our multi-language posts correctly linked so each market sees the right version.
Dig into server logs. You’ll analyse server logs to catch technical issues early, before they become bigger problems.
Be the team’s technical go-to.You’ll pick up ad hoc technical requests from the team and our SEO Specialist, and move quickly when something urgent comes up.
Open and lead our AI Search Lab.You’ll set up this initiative from scratch and run the first projects exploring how AI is reshaping search.
## What we’re looking for
Technical SEO experience.You’ve worked as a technical SEO, in an agency or in-house, and you’re comfortable with indexability, toxic links, hreflang and log analysis.
Hands-on AI experience.You’ve built AI skills or agents yourself, not just used off-the-shelf tools.
Comfortable with WordPress.You can maintain, clean up and build on an existing WordPress site without breaking things.
Mid to senior level.You don’t need heavy supervision once you’re up to speed.
A resolutive team player. You take ownership of problems, communicate clearly, and don’t wait to be told what to fix.
A stable, reliable schedule.You’re available during our core hours (roughly 9am to 5pm) so you can collaborate when the team needs you.
Spanish and English.Both are required; a language test is part of the process.
Learnable on the job, not required from day one: our use of Asana.
## What your first months will look like
Month 1: You’ll get to know the team, understand how our WordPress is set up, and get a clear picture of the team’s needs and the scope of the role.
Month 3:You’ll be handling day-to-day tasks confidently and settled into the rhythm of our recurring work.
Month 12: Our AI Search Lab will be up and running, with you leading the projects that keep Metricool ahead on how AI is changing search.
## Why you’ll love working at Metricool
100% Remote:Work from home with the equipment you need to do your job comfortably.
Flexible Schedule:We trust you to organize your own day around your life, staying available during core hours to collaborate with the team.
Health Insurance: Comprehensive coverage so you can work with peace of mind.
Language Lessons:Support to learn or improve a language and connect more easily with teammates across markets.
Learning Platform:Full access to Udemy courses so you can keep exploring whatever sparks your curiosity.
The Epic Weekend: Once a year, the whole company meets in person to disconnect, catch up, and celebrate the year together.
Salary:€38,000 – €44,000 gross per year, under the Spanish collective agreement for consulting, IT, and market and public opinion research companies (Convenio colectivo de empresas de consultoría, tecnologías de la información y estudios de mercado y de la opinión pública).
Room to grow:We’re scaling fast, and if you take ownership of your work, you’ll have plenty of space to shape your role.
The Process
First call with People & Culture, to talk about your background and check your Spanish and English level.
A deeper conversation with Merche and the team, to go through your experience in technical SEO and AI.
A language test in Spanish and English is part of the process.

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
About us
At Viasat, the work you do helps people stay connected in ways that matter, from everyday moments to critical missions across air, land, sea, and space.
We’re a place for people who are curious, bold, and motivated by meaningful work. Here, you'll have the opportunity to make an impact, explore new possibilities, and grow your career in ways that align with your interests and goals. When you're ready to take on something new, you'll find leaders who support your development and help you turn your ambition into action.
What you'll do
The Customer Engineering team is a group of highly technical engineers who are tasked with maintaining and developing the reliability, scalability, and performance of the Service to different Enterprise Customers. The Customer Engineering Team is empowered to drive technical resolutions across the technology stack from hardware through to application and all stops in between. The team is also responsible to build and maintain Alerts to proactively monitor the service and act as the technical liaison between Customer facing teams and the Engineering teams.
The day-to-day
As a Site Reliability Engineer, you will:
• Identify and investigate potential and actual customer performance problems, recommend, and prioritize remediation, and assess effectiveness of remediation actions
• Participate in and provide feedback on product design, especially regarding reliability and availability
• Drive initiatives with partner teams to improve the reliability and performance of the Service through improved system design
• Drive a culture of intolerance to manual activity which results in a highly automated environment delivering scalable solution
• Work Closely with Customer facing teams (Technical Account Mangers and Program Teams) to understand and prioritize the Customer issues
• Drive monitoring and automation initiatives
• Create and present Performance reports for technical and management stakeholders
• Work closely with Engineering teams to communicate and prioritize the service impacting issues
• Reproduce and test the Customer issues in the Lab
• Develop Automated scripts and tools to Enable monitoring of the Service
• Be part of on-call rotations
What you'll need
• 5+ years experience in troubleshooting and triage of technical issues in a fast paced environment, to support customers
• 5+ years experience in Network Operations or Product Support
• Advanced knowledge of modern programming languages, especially Python
• An ability to understand large complex systems and a passion to constantly improve environments
• Strong networking knowledge: TCP/IP, IPSEC, VPN, NAT, Routing Protocols, AAA
• Set priorities and work efficiently in a fast-paced environment
• Demonstrated ability to deliver results on time with high quality and attention to detail
• Demonstrated ability to work with ambiguous requirements, adapt, and learn

title: Structured Data Engineer - AI Search (Remote, Full-Time) [HR226] (PK)
description:
## About Smart Working
At Smart Working, we believe your job should not only look right on paper but also feel right every day. This isn’t just another remote opportunity - it’s about finding where you truly belong, no matter where you are. From day one, you’re welcomed into a genuine community that values your growth and well-being.
Our mission is simple: to break down geographic barriers and connect skilled professionals with outstanding global teams and products for full-time, long-term roles. We help you discover meaningful work with teams that invest in your success, where you’re empowered to grow personally and professionally.
Join one of the highest-rated workplaces on Glassdoor and experience what it means to thrive in a truly remote-first world.
## About the Role
As a Structured Data Engineer (AI Search), you will ensure ecommerce product data is accurate, comprehensive and machine-readable across AI search and shopping platforms. Your work will help AI systems reliably access, interpret and present product, pricing, availability and delivery information, improving product discoverability and overall ecommerce performance.
You will be an integral part of the AEO/GEO programme and engineering team, collaborating closely with the AEO/GEO Lead, engineering and platform teams, paid search, trading and product content teams.
This mid-to-senior-level role centres on enhancing structured data quality, maintaining accurate and consistent product information across large-scale catalogues, and supporting the next generation of AI-powered product discovery and shopping experiences.
## Responsibilities
• Develop and maintain template-level JSON-LD across product, category, content and brand pages, covering Product, ProductGroup, Offer, AggregateRating, Review, OfferShippingDetails, MerchantReturnPolicy and Organization.
• Generate structured markup directly from source systems, ensuring data remains accurate as prices, stock levels and customer reviews change.
• Build automated validation and monitoring processes to detect missing, broken or conflicting structured data.
• Manage and maintain product feed pipelines into Google Merchant Center and Microsoft Merchant Center, working closely with the paid search team.
• Develop product feeds and integrations for emerging AI shopping platforms and agentic commerce protocols.
• Ensure near real-time consistency of pricing, availability and delivery information across the website, structured markup and product feeds.
• Identify and address gaps in product attributes, including specifications, energy ratings, dimensions and compatibility details.
• Ensure pricing, delivery options and customer review information are accurately and consistently structured across relevant platforms.
• Work with PIM, catalogue and trading teams to identify and resolve product data quality issues at source.
• Ensure key content and structured markup are accessible in server-rendered HTML and discoverable by AI crawlers.
• Support log file analysis and crawler access optimisation in collaboration with the AEO/GEO Lead.
• Translate AEO/GEO insights into clearly defined, actionable and testable engineering tasks.
• Deliver technical changes through established Git workflows, code reviews, CI/CD pipelines and release processes.
• Ensure product data and structured markup are ready ahead of major retail events, including Black Friday and significant product launches.
• Participate in engineering stand-ups, sprint planning and team rituals during UK business hours.
• First 30 days: Understand the existing technology stack, PIM systems and feed pipelines, audit structured data and feed quality across priority categories, and establish a prioritised implementation backlog.
• Days 31–60: Implement corrected, source-driven structured markup across high-traffic templates and address critical pricing, availability and product attribute inconsistencies.
• Days 61–90: Introduce automated validation and monitoring, expand coverage across the product catalogue and document processes for ongoing maintenance.
• Work towards fully automated, validated and monitored structured markup and product feeds across priority categories within the first 90 days.
• Measure progress against the initial audit, including structured data coverage and validity, pricing and availability consistency, product attribute completeness and Merchant Center feed health.
• Monitor data quality issues and increase the proportion of errors identified and resolved before they affect customers or AI systems.
• Support improvements in AI search visibility, measured through the AEO/GEO Lead's citation and factual accuracy metrics.
## Requirements
• 4+ years of experience in backend, data or integration engineering, with at least 2 years in ecommerce or retail technology.
• Strong Python programming skills, sound SQL knowledge and practical experience with ETL processes and data pipeline tools.
• At least 2 years of hands-on experience managing ecommerce product data, including Product Information Management (PIM) systems, catalogue structures, product attributes and variants.
• Solid understanding of JSON-LD and schema.org, or the technical capability to quickly develop expertise and implement structured data correctly.
• Proven experience developing and maintaining product feeds for Google Merchant Center or comparable platforms.
• Working knowledge of server-side rendering, caching, Content Delivery Networks (CDNs) and how search engine and AI crawlers access and interpret web content.
• Experience implementing automated testing, validation and monitoring processes to maintain data quality.
• Practical experience with Git, code reviews and CI/CD pipelines within an established engineering environment.
• Ability to maintain accurate, consistent and reliable data across large-scale ecommerce product catalogues.
• Strong communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical teams and commercial stakeholders.
## Nice to Have
• Experience with Magento/Adobe Commerce, Salesforce Commerce Cloud or a headless commerce technology stack.
• Experience with Microsoft Merchant Center, Bing Webmaster Tools or marketplace product feeds.
• Exposure to agentic commerce, AI shopping integrations or Large Language Model (LLM) APIs.
• Experience with BigQuery or another cloud data warehouse.
• Background working with consumer electrical products or other specification-heavy product categories.

title: AI Infrastructure Operations Engineer
description:
## AI Infrastructure & Operations Engineer
Location: Remote (U.S.)
Reports To: Juan Sandoval-Tobias
## About Private Health Management
Private Health Management guides patients and families through the chaos and complexity of serious medical care, for cancer and beyond. As an independent advocate and trusted partner during healthcare's most challenging moments, our team of experts works alongside physicians to orchestrate the best treatment, advocacy, and support to deliver measurably better outcomes.
Everyone deserves great care. We make sure they get it.
## About the Role
PHM is building and scaling Companion, an AI-enabled clinical platform operating in a high-trust healthcare environment where reliability, observability, and security are foundational requirements. The platform includes headless AI agents designed to support clinical and operational professionals by acting as intelligent workstations that integrate with enterprise applications and workflows.
The AI Infrastructure & Operations Engineer will operationalize the platform so it runs reliably at production scale, helping ensure the systems behind Companion are observable, recoverable, secure, and maintainable as adoption grows.
This role sits at the intersection of Kubernetes operations, AI platform reliability, observability engineering, and operational security. You will help evolve and maintain the Azure-based infrastructure stack while partnering closely with technology leadership, AI architects, and security stakeholders. This is a high-ownership role for someone who thrives in fast-moving environments, is comfortable operating with incomplete information, and enjoys building operational discipline around emerging AI systems.
## What You’ll Accomplish
• Establish operational reliability for Companion across AKS infrastructure, AI agent workloads, monitoring systems, and deployment pipelines.
• Build meaningful observability practices that help PHM understand platform behavior, usage trends, and operational risks before they become incidents.
• Create sustainable operational hygiene around patching, CVE remediation, secrets rotation, dependency management, and cloud maintenance cycles.
• Strengthen platform resilience, documentation, and operational processes so the environment can scale without relying on tribal knowledge.
## How You’ll Spend Your Days
## Operate and Improve Platform Reliability
• Monitor and maintain AKS infrastructure, AI agent workloads, deployment pipelines, and support Azure services.
• Investigate incidents, troubleshoot production issues, and improve platform resilience through better operational patterns and tooling.
• Support release operations and help ensure deployments remain stable, observable, and recoverable.
## Build Observability and Operational Insight
• Develop dashboards, alerts, logging patterns, and operational baselines using Azure Log Analytics and Application Insights.
• Identify system trends, performance bottlenecks, and emerging operational risks across infrastructure and AI workloads.
• Improve visibility into AI agent behavior, enterprise workflow integrations, latency patterns, and system health under real user load.
## Strengthen Security and Operational Hygiene
• Maintain operational cadence for dependency updates, CVE remediation, image signing, secrets rotation, and cluster patching.
• Support security-first infrastructure practices across Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and Azure environments.
• Partner with security and engineering stakeholders to maintain compliance-aware operational practices in a HIPAA-regulated environment.
## Collaborate Across a Small, High-Ownership Team
• Work closely with technology leadership, platform engineers, security stakeholders, and AI architects to evolve the operational maturity of Companion.
• Contribute documentation, operational runbooks, and shared knowledge that reduce platform fragility over time.
• Help establish practical operational patterns for AI systems where industry best practices are still emerging.
## What You Bring to the Table
## Required
• Strong hands-on Kubernetes operations experience, including troubleshooting workloads, admission controllers, cluster networking, and production incidents.
• Experience supporting cloud-native infrastructure in Azure environments, particularly AKS and related operational tooling.
• Demonstrated strength in monitoring, observability, and incident response using structured logging and metrics platforms.
• SRE mindset with experience handling on-call responsibilities, operational prioritization, and post-incident analysis.
• Comfort operating in fast-moving environments with incomplete documentation, evolving processes, and broad ownership areas.
• Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to explain technical issues clearly across technical and non-technical audiences.
## Nice to Have
• Experience with CI/CD pipeline tooling including GitHub Actions, Kaniko, cosign, image signing, or Actions Runner Controller.
• Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code practices using Bicep or Azure resource automation tooling.
• Exposure to HIPAA, SOC2, or other compliance-aware operational environments.
• Experience supporting AI or LLM-backed applications in production environments.
## Compensation
The target base salary for this position is $140000 - $160000
This base salary is only a part of a total compensation package that also includes health/dental/vision benefits, annual cash incentive program, 401k with match, flexible PTO, PHM for PHM — our services for you and your dependents — and other benefits. Individual pay may vary from the target range as several factors including market forces, experience, location, disparities in market data, and other relevant business considerations may all factor into final compensation.
## Location
This is a remote role requiring that you live in and physically perform all work in the United States.
## Next Steps
Private Health Management is a remote company with employees around the United States. We’re committed to providing a thoughtful, transparent interview experience and meaningful opportunities to get to know our company, mission, and wonderful teammates through fully remote interviews.
If your application is selected for interviews, you’ll hear from a member of our recruiting team to schedule next steps. Interviews will also include the hiring manager, peers, and often an executive from the department.
PHM uses AI-enabled tools at certain points in the recruiting process to help identify and evaluate top talent; however, all hiring decisions are made by human reviewers.
Have a quick question about the role? Email or simply apply here.
Anticipated Pay Range
$140,000—$160,000 USD

Save lives, from the workplace to anyplace.

The eLearning Developer will support NSC’s growing Training Product Development team by building high-quality digital learning experiences that align with NSC’s mission, standards, and instructional vision. • Experience creating and standardizing best practices

title: Data Engineer
description:
Join a company that’s leading the way in AI and automation consulting. Our portfolio spans 10+ top technologies across business applications, data, process, cloud, and AI. At Bits In Glass, you’ll do meaningful work with a supportive, driven team that loves to collaborate and celebrate wins together. Whether you’re coding, consulting or bringing bold ideas to the table, you’ll tackle real business challenges, grow your skills, and make a BIG impact.
Our growing team has earned global recognition as a Great Place to Work and received multiple industry partner awards—while keeping things fun and people-focused. If you’re looking to deepen your expertise and solve real-world problems, Bits In Glass could be the place for you
As a Data Engineer, you will be an integral part of our team, working on data pipelines, data warehousing, and data integration for various analytics and AI use cases. You will collaborate closely with Delivery Managers, ML Engineers and other stakeholders to ensure seamless data flow and accessibility. Your expertise will be crucial in enabling data-driven decision-making for our clients. To thrive in this role, you need to be a quick learner, get excited about innovation and be on the constant lookout to master new technologies as they come up in the Data, AI & Cloud realms.
## Key Responsibilities
• Build and maintain scalable batch and streaming pipelines (ETL/ELT) for analytics and AI.
• Ingest data from OLTP databases, files, SaaS apps, and APIs into the lakehouse.
• Prepare data for ML and GenAI use cases with ML Engineers.
• Translate client data requirements into tailored solutions.
• Ensure data quality, security, and governance.
• Optimize cloud storage and compute for performance and cost.
• Use Databricks as the primary platform for processing and orchestration.
• Monitor, troubleshoot, and improve pipeline reliability.
• Apply best practices: version control, code review, testing, CI/CD, and documentation.
• Contribute to technical design and mentor junior team members.
## Qualifications
• Education: Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience.
• Experience: 3–5 years building production data pipelines.
• Programming: Strong SQL and Python (including PySpark).
• Distributed processing: Partitioning, joins, and performance tuning (e.g., Apache Spark on Databricks).
• Lakehouse architecture: Medallion architecture and open table formats (e.g., Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg).
• Declarative pipelines and orchestration: e.g., Lakeflow Spark Declarative Pipelines, Lakeflow Jobs, Airflow, dbt.
• Data ingestion: Batch, incremental, CDC, and API ingestion (e.g., Lakeflow Connect, Auto Loader, Fivetran, Azure Data Factory, AWS Glue).
• Batch and streaming: Streaming concepts such as watermarking and late data (e.g., Spark Structured Streaming).
• OLTP and OLAP: How transactional and analytical systems differ and integrate (e.g., PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Databricks Lakebase).
• Data modeling: Relational and dimensional modeling, including star schemas and SCDs.
• Data warehousing: e.g., Databricks SQL, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift.
• Data quality: Validation, monitoring, and alerting (e.g., pipeline expectations, Lakehouse Monitoring).
• Governance and security: Access control (RBAC/ABAC), PII masking, and lineage (e.g., Unity Catalog).
• Cloud platforms: At least one of AWS, Azure, or GCP.
• DevOps and CI/CD: Git, automated testing, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code (e.g., Databricks Asset Bundles, Terraform).
• Soft skills: Strong problem-solving, communication, and collaboration.
## Highly Desirable Skills
• Vector databases: e.g., Databricks Vector Search, pgvector, Pinecone.
• GenAI data pipelines: Preparing unstructured data for RAG and AI agents (e.g., Databricks AI Functions, Agent Bricks).
• Real-time streaming: e.g., Apache Kafka, Azure Event Hubs, Amazon Kinesis.
• Operational data serving: Serving data to applications (e.g., Lakebase, FastAPI, Databricks Apps).
• ML lifecycle: Feature engineering and model tracking (e.g., MLflow, Feature Store).
• NoSQL and graph databases: e.g., MongoDB, Cosmos DB, Neo4j.
• BI and semantic layer: e.g., Unity Catalog metric views, AI/BI and Genie, Power BI, Tableau.
• Certifications: Databricks Data Engineer Associate/Professional or a cloud data certification.
• Consulting: Client-facing and Agile delivery experience.
BIG is a high growth Cloud Consulting firm with offices in Edmonton, Calgary, Toronto, Denver, India and the United Kingdom. Our clients are in Canada, UK, India and the US. Our vast experience in the IT industry and our current track record in enterprise software development, allow us to provide a full range of services to our clients. Bits In Glass helps organizations of all sizes to automate their businesses and leverage the power of the web and mobile technologies.

title: Founding Software Engineer - Vimes
description:
## Founding Software Engineer - Vimes
## 👯 ABOUT US
Vimes is building the universal operating system for government welfare, starting with child protection: our cross‑platform crisis‑intervention software replaces the paper trails and traditional email threads that slow schools, hospitals, police, and social‑services agencies.
At it's core, we build software to save kids' lives and In 12 months we launched a nationally adopted child‑risk metric, published an academically validated white paper, and cut average response times from 40 days to 12 hours for 18 police departments covering 320K citizens. Having recently closed a $2.2M pre-seed, we envision becoming the universal system of record for all of public safety, becoming a central hub for data and communications for all vulnerable populations.
We have a pipeline of 30+ cities, 15 states, and may cross $10M revenue barrier in the next 12 months. As we scale 10x and we’re looking for talented technical engineers to join us.
## 🌱 THE ROLE
We’re looking to bring on founding engineers, for an in-person position in New York City or Bay Area (open to hybrid or remote but MUST LIVE IN U.S.).
As a small team, we work in a highly collaborative environment and you'll have the opportunity to participate in varying stages of the technical process, reporting to the CTO/CEO.
## ⚙️ WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR (non-exhaustive list)
Highly skilled in React/React Native, iOS/Android app development
Experience working with AWS-related services
Have a startup-y background or love bringing products from concept to reality: the 0 → 1 phase.
Plus for extensive experience in security engineering + compliance (SOC2, HIPAA, CJIS, StateRamp etc.)
Plus for experience at govtech startup
Plus for design experience!
Experience writing production code on shipped full-stack apps
Experience working with communication platforms
Experience with building no-SQL and SQL database schemas
Be able to learn new tech / anything relevant quickly
## 📱 WHAT THINGS YOU (MIGHT) DO
App. You’ll be working with the team to build out our mobile and web app, laying the foundations for a large-scale government and social impact product and influencing direction of our stack.
Features. We’ve mastered our first product and system: child abuse data communication. As we expand, you will be rapidly building and testing new features like new communication methods, integrated database access, etc.; as well as new systems like domestic violence and gun violence frameworks.
Security. We have spent a lot of time building a secure system. You'll be helping us scale towards stateRAMP and fedRAMP compliance.
Data. You'll help in generating data-driven insights (ie. 50-pg reports to police chiefs) AND working on integrating with current gov. databases to securely integrate our product
Managing. You will be placed in a unique position to have capable Stanford SWE interns at your disposal to streamline your efficiency and productivity. Working with the CTO, you will have the ability to build leadership and managerial skills working with our interns.
Building UI components. You will work closely with our designers to think deeply about optimizing user experience and streamlining how our users will interact with the tech.
Solving interesting technical problems. Bring your full creativity to solve any technical challenges along the way.
## 💌 COMPENSATION
You will be joining a small-team, high-velocity startup and thus will be compensated competitively. Some terms:
Competitive salary + offers equity
Performance bonus
Relocation compensation (if moving to the Bay Area / New York)
Monthly stipend for meals
Health insurance + 401K match
In any case, we hope you’ll join us because you find a fast-paced production velocity exciting and fulfilling, and you want to help us prove what’s possible.

title: Research Engineer - Web Crawlers
description:
## About ElevenLabs
ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.
We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.
We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:
ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.
ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.
ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.
Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.
## How we work
High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.
Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.
AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.
Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.
Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.
## What we offer
Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.
Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.
Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.
Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.
Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.
## About the role
We are looking for a Research Engineer to join the research team at ElevenLabs, focused on large-scale web crawling for our frontier AI models. The quality of our models is bounded by the quality and scale of the data behind them, and you will own the crawling systems that source world-class data from the open web. You will thrive in this role if you enjoy:
Building and operating large-scale, distributed web crawlers that discover, fetch, and extract data across billions of pages reliably and efficiently.
Solving hard crawling problems such as content extraction from messy HTML, deduplication at web scale, freshness and recrawl strategies, and politeness and rate-limit handling.
Designing targeted crawling pipelines that find high-value data sources, including audio, video, and multilingual content, and turn them into clean training-ready datasets.
Creating tooling and infrastructure that lets researchers request, monitor, and explore newly crawled web data quickly and reliably.
## Requirements
We do not require any formal certifications or degrees. Instead, we are seeking enthusiastic engineers who can showcase solving impressively hard problems with artifacts such as past projects, designs, or GitHub contributions. Ideally, you bring:
Hands-on experience building and scaling web crawlers or scraping systems, ideally in support of machine learning training data.
Strong engineering skills in distributed systems at scale (e.g., Kubernetes, queue-based architectures, or custom pipelines processing billions of documents).
The capacity to autonomously evaluate the quality, coverage, and compliance of crawled data, and to build the tooling to measure it.
## Location
This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw.
#LI-Remote
We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

Wir sind eine dedizierte Data-&-AI-Beratung sowie ein Service Provider mit End-to-End-Umsetzung und begleiten Unternehmen von der strategischen Zielsetzung bis zur operativen Realisierung – strategisch, umsetzungsstark und ergebnisorientiert. Unsere Mission: Ambitionierte Unternehmen befähigen, Data & AI in geschäftskritischen Mehrwert zu verwandeln – mit strategischer Klarheit, technischer Exzellenz und unternehmerischer Umsetzung.
Von der Datenstrategie über KI- und Use-Case-Implementierung in interdisziplinären Teams bis zu skalierbaren Plattformen – wir begleiten unsere Kunden entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette. Wir sind branchenagnostisch – mit viel Erfahrung in kundennahen digitalen Geschäftsmodellen, insbesondere in Medien und Sport.
Was uns auszeichnet
• End-to-End-Ansatz: Von der Business-Strategie bis zum laufenden Betrieb.
• Klare Werte: Perform. Grow. Communicate. Dedicate. Balance.
• Wachstum & Entwicklung: Weiterbildungsbudget, Mentoring & individuelle Karrierepfade.
• Flexibilität: Moderne Arbeitsmodelle mit Remote-Optionen (1x Woche fixer Office Day).

Deine Rolle – Data Engineer
Du willst nicht nur mit Daten arbeiten, sondern das Fundament bauen, auf dem alles läuft? In deiner Rolle als Data Engineer konzipierst, baust und betreibst du die Datenpipelines und Plattformen, die unsere Analysen, Dashboards und KI-Use-Cases mit zuverlässigen Daten versorgen. Du sorgst dafür, dass Daten aus unterschiedlichsten Quellen sauber, performant und skalierbar dort ankommen, wo sie gebraucht werden und arbeitest dabei eng mit Data Scientists, Analysten und unseren Kunden zusammen.
## Aufgaben
• Aufbau & Betrieb von Datenpipelines: Du entwickelst, testest und betreibst robuste ETL/ELT-Pipelines, die Daten aus unterschiedlichsten Quellen zuverlässig ingestieren, transformieren und bereitstellen.
• Datenmodellierung & Architektur: Du entwirfst und pflegst Datenmodelle, Schemata und Strukturen für Data Warehouses/Lakehouses, die analytische und operative Use Cases sauber unterstützen.
• Datenqualität & Zuverlässigkeit: Du implementierst Validierungen, Qualitätschecks und Monitoring, damit Daten korrekt, konsistent und jederzeit verfügbar sind.
• Cloud & Skalierung: Du baust und optimierst Datenlösungen in der Cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), achtest auf Performance, Skalierbarkeit und Kosten und arbeitest mit Infrastruktur-as-Code.
• Automatisierung & Orchestrierung: Du automatisierst wiederkehrende Datenflüsse (z. B. mit Airflow) und sorgst mit CI/CD für saubere, wiederholbare Deployments.
• Enablement für Analytics & KI: Du stellst Data Scientists und Analysten performante, gut dokumentierte Datensätze bereit und unterstützt dabei, Modelle und Use Cases produktiv zu machen.
• Zusammenarbeit & Übersetzung: Du arbeitest eng mit interdisziplinären Teams und Kunden zusammen, verstehst fachliche Anforderungen und übersetzt sie in tragfähige technische Lösungen.
## Qualifikation
• Erfahrung im Data Engineering: Du hast bereits produktive Datenpipelines und -infrastruktur gebaut und betrieben und arbeitest gerne an sauberen, skalierbaren Lösungen.
• Tool-Stack: Du bist sicher im Umgang mit Python und SQL, kennst dich mit ETL/ELT, Data Warehouses/Lakehouses und einer Cloud-Umgebung (Databricks/Snowflake/AWS/Azure/GCP) aus; Erfahrung mit PySpark, Airflow und CI/CD ist ein Plus.
• Datenmodellierung & Qualitätsbewusstsein: Du verstehst Datenmodellierung und legst Wert auf Datenqualität, Tests und wartbaren Code.
• Umsetzungskompetenz & Eigenverantwortung: Du bringst Lösungen pragmatisch und zielorientiert von der Idee bis in den Betrieb und übernimmst Verantwortung für Ergebnis und Qualität.
• Teamplayer: Du arbeitest gerne mit Data Scientists, Analysten und Kunden zusammen und kommunizierst technische Sachverhalte klar.
• Sprachen: Fließende Deutschkenntnisse (C1+), gute Englischkenntnisse sind ein Plus.
## Benefits
• Du arbeitest in einem jungen, wachsenden Team mit der Möglichkeit, twomynds aktiv mitzugestalten und sehr nah an Geschäftsprozessen und Entscheidungen dabei zu sein.
• Möglichkeit, schnell Verantwortung zu übernehmen, intern aufzusteigen und dich fachlich wie persönlich weiterzuentwickeln – unterstützt durch Mentoring, Sparring und Weiterbildungsbudget.
• Flexible Arbeitszeiten und hohe Remote-Flexibilität (1x Woche fixer Office Day in Bonn).
• Du arbeitest an spannenden Projekten mit bekannten Marken aus Medien, Sport, Telekommunikation und Industrie – von strategischen Konzepten über Enablement bis zur Umsetzung.
• Zuschuss zum Jobticket und zur Urban Sports Club-Mitgliedschaft.

title: Supply Data Analyst
description:
Location: Any MSF office*
Contract: 100%
Duration: 12 months
Starting date: 04th of January 2027
Deadline to apply: 01st of December 2026
Compensation and Benefits: MSF practice is to offer the compensation and benefits package in line with the MSF entity offering the contract
*By default, the successful candidate will be offered a contract in the MSF office, able to issue a contract, of their country of residence at the time of application. If no MSF office exists in their country of residence, the successful candidate will be expected to relocate to a country where an MSF office can issue a contract, provided the local legislation allows for that.
At MSF, we are committed to an inclusive culture that encourages and supports the diverse voices of our employees. We welcome applications from individuals of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, nationalities, races, religions, beliefs, ability status, and all other diversity characteristics.
MSF is committed to preventing abuse, inappropriate behaviour, lack of integrity and financial misconduct in its work and care spaces. The successful candidate will be expected to comply with the organisation’s safeguarding policies and standards of professional behaviour.
We are committed to removing barriers for people with specific accessibility needs. If you need an adjustment to the recruitment process to be considered for the role, please let us know from the beginning of the selection process.
MSF International
Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) is an international, independent, medical humanitarian organisation that delivers emergency aid to people affected by armed conflict, epidemics, healthcare exclusion and natural disasters. MSF offers assistance to people based only on need and irrespective of race, religion, gender or political affiliation. MSF International is the legal entity that binds MSF’s 26 sections, 28 associations and 16 branch offices together. Registered in Switzerland, MSF International provides coordination, information and support to the MSF Movement, as well as implements international projects and initiatives as requested.
I. CONTEXT
MSF consists of 6 Operational Centres (OCs) and 3 European Supply Centres (ESCs). In the supply domain there is a joint Supply Tansformational Topics Roadmap composed by several inter-OC and inter-ESC projects, and their number is growing due to the need to increase cooperation between MSF entities while improving the quality of MSF's supply chain. The capacity to measure performance and analyse data across different entities is therefore essential and is contributing to MSF ambitions on interoperability and climate.
The role of the International Office is to foster cooperation and coordination between MSF entities. The Supply Data Analyst will therefore act as a facilitator between the OCs and ESCs: bringing their representatives together, helping them build shared approaches on supply data and performance, and turning these agreements into concrete deliverables.
The Global Supply Data & Analytics (GSDA) team (previously SCPM) has been actively working to build the analytical and data foundations needed to support a global approach to supply chain performance management, and to contribute to the governance of supply data across entities. The team is led by the Supply Chain Analytics Manager and includes one Data Analysts and one data governance specialist; the Supply Data Analyst will join it as an additional analyst.
Reporting hierarchically and functionally to the Supply Chain Analytics Manager, the Supply Data Analyst will: collaborate closely with the supply chain professionals responsible for BI and performance management within the 6 OCs and 3 ESCs; work in close link with the ShARP (Shared Analytics and Reporting Project) team in SITS (Shared IT Services); on the existing UniField intersection reports; work alongside the GSDA team and the IO Supply team on projects related to supply chain data analytics; and interact with stakeholders across MSF, including finance, IT, medical, pharmacy, logistics and operations teams.
II. PURPOSE OF THE JOB
The Supply Data Analyst supports supply chain performance analysis and decision making across MSF by delivering reliable data, KPIs, reports and actionable recommendations. The position also fosters cooperation between the OCs and ESCs around shared supply data, turning agreements into concrete deliverables.
Within GSDA, the Supply Data Analyst will support the growing need for data management, reporting and analytics from the supply chain teams, including the monitoring of KPIs and the analysis of data coming from MSF information systems (such as UniField, Isystock or Akiba).
III. ACCOUNTABILITIES
The Supply Data Analyst is accountable for the following expected results and the activities deployed to achieve them.
1. UniField intersection reports are reliable, relevant and meet the needs of the OCs
a. Take over the existing UniField intersection reports in close link with the ShARP team and improve them (reliability, relevance, usability) based on users' feedback and identified gaps
b. Collect the reporting needs of each OC and consolidate them into a clear, prioritised set of requirements
c. Design and deliver new intersection reports in coordination with the ShARP team, with validation from the OC representatives
2. Supply data is available and of reliable quality for analysis
a. Extract, clean and consolidate supply data from UniField and other information systems
b. Check data consistency and quality, and report anomalies to the relevant teams
c. Document data sources, definitions and calculation methods
3. KPIs and reporting solutions support decision making
a. Calculate and update a set of KPIs on a regular basis, in coordination with the teams concerned
b. Build and maintain ad hoc data reporting solutions (Power BI) providing visuals that accurately summarise supply chain activities while providing actionable insights
c. Support the teams in the definition of additional KPIs as needs arise
4. Stakeholders receive relevant data analysis and actionable recommendations
a. Support stakeholders on supply data analysis
b. Respond to ad hoc data and analysis requests using supply data from different stakeholders (supply, finance, medical…)
c. Present analysis results and recommendations in a clear way to non-technical audiences
5. Cooperation between the OCs and ESCs on supply data produces concrete deliverables
a. Convene and facilitate working groups and meetings with representatives of each OC and ESC, from preparation (agenda, pre-alignment of positions) to follow-up (minutes, actions, deadlines)
b. Lead discussions between entities with different needs and practices, and build compromises and consensus on shared definitions, KPIs and ways of working
c. Turn agreements into concrete deliverables (e.g., shared KPI definitions, dashboards, documentation) and follow their delivery
6. Data-related tools and processes improve continuously and stakeholders are kept informed
a. Contribute to the improvement of data-related tools and processes within the team
b. Proactively identify data needs, risks and improvement opportunities, and propose solutions autonomously
c. Manage stakeholders and expectations: identify their needs, keep them informed, and escalate blockers to the Supply Chain Analytics Manager when needed
IV. AUTONOMY, COMPLEXITY
Challenges and decisions that the job faces to achieve the accountabilities:
Autonomy to think and act: works with limited supervision; takes initiative, prioritises and drives work to completion, proactively identifies data needs, risks and improvement opportunities, and escalates blockers to the Supply Chain Analytics Manager when needed.
Complexity of the environment: works across 6 OCs and 3 ESCs with different needs, practices and information systems (UniField, Isystock, Akiba); builds compromises on shared definitions and KPIs, handles multiple priorities at once, and interacts with technical and non-technical stakeholders (finance, IT, medical, pharmacy, logistics, operations) in a cross-cultural and cross-functional environment.
SAFEGUARDING REQUIREMENTS FOR THE ROLE
The incumbent commits to contribute to a safe, supportive, inclusive, equitable, diverse, respectful, and healthy workplace, free from abuse and other misconduct. They will not engage in any form of abuse including those detailed in MSF Typologies of Abuse and when an employee suspects or observes abuse, they will report it (without investigating it) to protect others.
Education
Bachelor's level or above in data analytics, statistics, business management, supply chain or a related field, or a combination of relevant education and professional experience (essential)
Experience
Minimum of 2 years of experience as Data Analyst (essential)
Direct work experience involving significant data management (essential)
Experience in facilitating meetings or working groups involving multiple stakeholders and in delivering concrete outputs from them (essential)
Supply chain, logistics and Finance experience in NGO's operational settings (desirable)
Previous work experience with UniField, MSF's main ERP software (desirable)
Skills
Strong stakeholder management and facilitation skills: ability to bring together representatives of different entities, lead effective meetings, negotiate compromises and deliver concrete outcomes
Strong analytical skills
Good organisational skills, ability to handle multiple priorities at one time
Autonomous and proactive: ability to take initiative, prioritise and drive work to completion with limited supervision
Good level skills in Excel, Power BI and database management
Ability to work in a cross-cultural and cross-functional environment

title: Research Engineer / Research Scientist, Post-Training — Collective Alignment (User Signals)
description:
About the Team

The Collective Alignment (User Signals) team is a post-training research team working at the intersection of data science, human feedback, and reinforcement learning. We develop methods for learning from real-world user interactions to build AI systems that deliver lasting value, helping people learn, grow, and accomplish increasingly complex goals with ChatGPT.

Learning from user feedback presents fundamental research challenges: signals are often noisy, biased, and difficult to interpret, and improvements in offline metrics do not always translate into better experiences for users. Our team develops scientific approaches to understanding these signals and translating them into improvements in model behavior through evaluations, reward modeling, and post-training.

About the Role

As a Research Engineer or Research Scientist, you will investigate how AI systems can learn from human feedback and real-world usage to better serve users over time.

You will develop new approaches to extracting meaningful learning signals from complex user interactions and incorporating those signals into model training.

This role requires strong deep learning research skills, scientific rigor, and curiosity about how people interact with AI. You will design controlled experiments and ablations, critically examine the relationship between offline evaluations and online model behavior, and work closely with research, product, and data science teams to understand whether improvements translate into meaningful value for users.

In this role, you will:

 - Develop novel methods for learning from human feedback and user interaction signals.

 - Research approaches to incorporating feedback into reward modeling, reinforcement learning, and post-training.

 - Design rigorous experiments and ablation studies to isolate the effects of new data, objectives, and training methods.

 - Develop offline evaluations and investigate their relationship with online experiments and real-world user outcomes.

 - Analyze unexpected results, investigate discrepancies between evaluation metrics and user behavior, and develop hypotheses to guide further research.

 - Evaluate tradeoffs and regressions to improve targeted model behaviors while preserving broader capabilities.

 - Collaborate with research, alignment, product, and data science teams.

 - Implement and debug experiments across large-scale deep learning research systems.

You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Have a strong background in deep learning research through academic or industry experience.

 - Have demonstrated research ability through publications or substantive research contributions in deep learning or LLM post-training.

 - Have experience developing new machine learning methods and evaluating them through rigorous, hypothesis-driven experimentation.

 - Think critically about experimental design, measurement, and what evaluation results do and do not establish about model behavior.

 - Are comfortable designing ablations, investigating surprising results, and reasoning about the relationship between offline metrics and real-world outcomes.

 - Have strong programming skills and experience working with complex ML codebases.

 - Are curious about how people interact with AI and how those interactions can inform better models.

Nice to have:

 - Experience with RLHF, reinforcement learning, or modern LLM post-training.

 - Research or demonstrated interest in AI alignment, human feedback, or user signals.

 - Experience with online experimentation, evaluation methodology, or learning from noisy and biased feedback.

 - Experience connecting machine learning research with real-world product behavior.

title: Research Engineer/Research Scientist-Post Training, Proactivity
description:
About the Team

The Proactivity Research team, within OpenAI’s broader Post Training team, is focused on making our models in ChatGPT, Dots, and future potential products proactive in ways that are truly useful. We're laying the technical foundations for AI that can anticipate what users need in real time, adapt as their goals and preferences shift, and build a deeper, evolving understanding of the person it's helping.

About the Role

As a Research Engineer / Scientist, you will research and develop improvements to our models’ personalization and agentic capabilities. Our team works on reinforcement learning, dataset creation, evaluations, and other post-training methods. We partner closely with research and product teams across the company to realize the vision of a highly personalized, collaborative, and proactive assistant.

We're looking for individuals with strong ML engineering skills and research experience, especially with novel and highly capable models. An ideal candidate is passionate about product-driven research.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

 - Own and pursue a research agenda to improve the proactivity and ability of our models to anticipate user needs and further their goals.

 - Build robust evaluations for tracking modeling improvements.

title: Research Engineer / Research Scientist, Human Flourishing
description:
About the Team

The Human Flourishing team’s mission is to ensure AI systems understand and advance human flourishing. As AI becomes more capable and plays a larger role in people’s lives, we want its human benefits to grow with its capabilities. The Human Flourishing team is part of the broader Post Training organization.

Our approach has two parts. Firstly, we measure and improve models’ understanding, capability, and propensity to act according to people’s values and to help them achieve their long-term goals. Secondly, we directly scale tangible impact for users in human domains like education and mental health, working across research, product, and partnerships to increase the benefits over a billion people experience weekly when they use ChatGPT.

Our recent work includes Beneficial RL https://alignment.openai.com/beneficial-rl/, which investigates how training for beneficial behavior generalizes across settings, and MentalHealthBench https://openai.com/index/introducing-mentalhealthbench/, a benchmark developed with mental health experts to evaluate realistic conversations.

About the Role

We’re looking for an exceptional, hands-on researcher to turn difficult-to-define signals of long-term flourishing into measurable improvements in model behavior. You’ll help set research direction, build what is needed to test your ideas, and drive successful work into the models and products we ship.

We’re especially interested in researchers with deep experience improving frontier models through pretraining or reinforcement learning (RL) / post-training, especially on less verifiable problems, or researchers who combine strong LLM skills with deep expertise in domains like education or mental health. Prior experience in these domains is not required.

In this role, you will

 - Develop scalable training methods across the training stack that improve how models understand people’s values, support their agency, and help them achieve long-term goals.

 - Lead high-leverage research from an open question to a shipped improvement: choose a hard-to-define problem, iteratively define success, run experiments, and integrate into frontier models.

 - Build RL environments for difficult-to-verify outcomes, and study whether beneficial behavior generalizes across settings.

 - Create evaluations grounded in human expertise and feedback that reveal capability gaps, unintended incentives in RL, and failures that aggregate scores can miss.

 - Test whether measures of model behavior predict better learning, wellbeing, and other long-term outcomes, and use those findings to guide training.

 - Build new 0→1 capabilities in human domains that may have an increasing impact with upcoming increases in model intelligence and test-time compute.

 - Partner with product teams, engineers, partnerships teams, and domain experts to deploy promising methods, measure their effects in real use, and turn what you learn into further improvements.

 - Assess AI’s impacts on human flourishing at the scale of over a billion users.

You might thrive in this role if you

 - Care deeply about helping AI improve people’s lives, and feel this is a responsibility that comes with increasingly capable models.

 - Have an unusually strong research record in pretraining or RL / post-training research, especially in a hard-to-verify area; or combine strong LLM research skills with deep expertise in education, mental health, or a related field of human benefit.

 - Are a hands-on builder who can turn ideas into rigorous experiments, write and debug code, and work directly with data and training infrastructure.

 - Have the taste to choose consequential problems and actionable steps on the path to solving those problems.

 - Take ownership of ambiguous problems and choose methods based on the impact they can deliver, including when the most useful work is unglamorous.

 - Care about whether a capability will scale, generalize, and make it into the real world—not just whether it can be shown in a paper or prototype.

 - Work well across disciplines and can grok the most important bottlenecks to scaling our impact in a multidisciplinary problem.

If you’re excited about ensuring AI systems advance human flourishing, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Research Engineer / Research Scientist, Health
description:
About the Team

The Health team, within OpenAI’s broader Post Training organization, has a mission to ensure AGI improves health for all humanity.

Improving human health will be one of the defining impacts of AGI. Hundreds of millions of people already turn to ChatGPT for questions about their health and millions of clinicians use it weekly to support care delivery. Increasingly capable models create an opportunity to make high-quality medical intelligence more accessible across patients and clinicians—raising the floor of human health—and accelerate the new capabilities and scientific advances that raise the ceiling of human health.

Our job is to make those benefits real. We work across the full model stack—pretraining, midtraining, reinforcement learning, post-training, evaluations, harnessing, and deployment—and connect that research to the patients, clinicians, and real-world outcomes we aim to improve.

About the Role

We’re looking for an exceptional, hands-on researcher who wants to build frontier health capabilities and turn them into impact at scale. This is a role for someone who can take an important, underdefined problem from 0→1: identify the right bet, build what’s needed to test it, and drive it all the way to a measurable improvement in the models and products we actually ship.

We’re especially excited about two kinds of people: researchers with the technical depth to move the frontier in pretraining, reinforcement learning (RL) / post-training, or evals; and researchers with real depth in developing frontier biomedical AI capabilities. Prior experience in healthcare is helpful but not required. Research excellence, velocity, ownership, and alignment with the mission are most important to us.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

 - Own a high-leverage research direction end to end—from deciding which problem matters and how to measure it, to designing and running experiments, to integrating successful work into frontier models.

 - Develop scalable methods across pretraining, midtraining, reinforcement learning, and post-training to improve health reasoning, knowledge, reliability, calibration, and behavior.

 - Build and study RL environments grounded in real health problems; understand which data and training setups produce robust, generalizable improvements rather than just higher benchmark scores.

 - Create meaningful, trustworthy, and unsaturated evaluations that tell us whether our models are actually getting better at what matters for patients and clinicians.

 - Advance new 0→1 capabilities in health that may have an increasing impact with upcoming increases in model intelligence and test-time compute.

 - Develop models and agents that can work over longitudinal, multimodal health data to produce useful predictions, surface new scientific insights, and support better individual- and population-level decisions.

 - Work closely with researchers, engineers, clinicians, and product teams to bring health capabilities into the models and products used by hundreds of millions of people.

 - Help establish that AI improves real health outcomes, not just that it can produce impressive answers or demos.

You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Care deeply about using increasingly capable AI to improve human health, and take seriously the responsibility of deploying it safely.

 - Have an unusually strong track record in machine learning or AI research, with the depth to push at least one important area forward: pretraining, reinforcement learning / post-training, evals (not necessarily specific to health); or substantial depth in a relevant frontier health / biomedical AI problem.

 - Are a hands-on builder: you can design experiments, write and debug code, work directly with data and training infrastructure, and move quickly from an idea to evidence.

 - Have strong research taste and can distinguish an important problem or a promising approach from an interesting one.

 - Own ambiguous problems end to end, and are willing to learn whatever is missing to get the job done.

 - Stay goal-oriented rather than method-oriented, and don’t shy away from unglamorous work if it is the highest-leverage path to impact.

 - Care about whether a capability will scale, generalize, and make it into the real world—not just whether it can be shown in a paper or prototype.

 - Enjoy working with low-ego, ambitious people across research, engineering, medicine, and product.

 - Bonus: Experience with health AI, longitudinal health data, or clinical research.

 

If you want your work to help make medical intelligence widely accessible—and to work on some of the most important frontier problems at the intersection of AI, science, and human health—we’d love to hear from you.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Overview:
As a Data Engineer at Sagent, you will help build an entirely new data ecosystem that forms the backbone of our next-generation, event- and API-based financial servicing platform. This platform is being built from the ground up as a cloud-enabled, real-time, data-first solution, and your work will shape how data is collected, moved, stored, and trusted across it.
The ideal candidate is a hands-on data engineering expert who brings deep knowledge of data integration, migration, and pipeline development on a modern cloud platform. You will collaborate with data analysts, architects, and product and engineering teams to design scalable data solutions that support our mortgage servicing platform and analytics initiatives.
Your day-to-day at Sagent:
Data Integration and Pipeline Development:
• Create data collection frameworks for structured and unstructured data.
• Develop and maintain data integration pipelines (ETL or native cloud pipelines), including data warehousing and online transactional processing (OLTP).
• Implement ETL pipelines within and outside of a data warehouse using SQL and Python.
• Develop scripts for loading, extracting, and transforming data.
• Implement data load strategies to relational databases and cloud data warehouses, and build data integration through distributed data processing pipelines.
• Handle both batch and streaming data using event streaming and cloud-based big-data processing technologies.
• Support data movement using microservices (direct ingestion), where applicable.
Cloud Data Solutions and Design:
• Serve as a hands-on subject matter expert in data movement, integration, and migration on a modern cloud platform and related technologies.
• Work with teams to design and implement modern, scalable data solutions using new and emerging cloud technologies.
• Review internal and external business and product requirements for data operations, and recommend changes and upgrades to systems and storage to accommodate ongoing needs.
• Design, develop, test, document, and analyze code for features of new or upgraded software systems and products.
• Develop and execute implementation in accordance with project plans and priorities.
Data Analysis and Quality:
• Analyze and organize raw data, build data systems and pipelines, and evaluate business needs and objectives.
• Interpret trends and patterns, conduct complex data analysis, and report on results.
• Explore ways to enhance data quality and reliability, and identify opportunities for data acquisition.
• Collaborate with data analysts and architects on a range of projects.
Operations, Automation, and Delivery:
• Apply Agile and DevOps techniques and implementation approaches in the delivery of data solutions.
• Automate and orchestrate data jobs.
• Test and troubleshoot issues as they arise, monitor and respond to defects, and resolve issues within established SLA timeframes.
• Manage and approve deployments into QA, UAT, and production environments.
• Apply expert SQL skills, including performance tuning, when querying relational databases and cloud data warehouses.
We would love to hear from you if you have:
• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, or relevant discipline with 3 - 4 years of experience in a related field. Experience will be considered in lieu of a degree.
• Hands-on, deep experience working with cloud data products and services for data processing, warehousing, pipeline orchestration, and storage.
• Working knowledge of distributed data processing frameworks and event streaming technologies.
• Working knowledge of relational databases and cloud data warehouse platforms.
• Expert SQL skills, including performance tuning.
• Capability in implementing cloud data solutions for batch and streaming workloads, along with SQL data analysis and programming interpretation.
• Excellent spoken and written communication skills.
• Excellent planning and task-tracking skills.
• Excellent analysis and assessment of business needs and cross-system impacts.Excellent team-play skills, with the ability to work in a fast-paced environment on multiple projects concurrently.
• Experience at a mortgage servicer and/or financial technology company.
• Working to mid-level knowledge of procedural SQL and ETL tools.
• Experience with microservices-based data ingestion.
Perks!
As a Sagent Associate, you will be eligible to participate in our benefit programs beginning on Day #1! We offer a comprehensive package including Remote/Hybrid workplace options, Health Benefits, Unlimited Flexible Time Off, Family Planning Services, Tuition Reimbursement, Paid Family Leave, 401(k) Matching, Pet Insurance, In-person and Virtual Social Experiences, Career Pathing, Focus Time Fridays and much, much more!
Why Sagent?
Sagent is transforming the mortgage servicing industry by bringing the modern experience customers now expect from loan originations to loan servicing. Our platform lets customers manage their home-owing lives from anywhere while giving servicers lower costs, scale compliance and higher servicing values through full market cycles.
Sagent is a joint venture that combines Fiserv Inc.'s decades of market-leading fintech expertise with Warburg Pincus' skill in growing technology companies. We hire innovators and doers to disrupt the last and most complex frontier of lending and housing. We're growing fast and need you to help shape our future.
Sagent is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.
Why you'll LOVE Sagent
You could work anywhere. We know you are talented and looking for something inspiring and impactful. A place where you will make a difference and have a great time doing it!
By choosing Sagent, you can be part of our mission to make loans and homeownership simpler and safer for all consumers.
Sagent powers servicers and consumers. You power Sagent!

title: Full-Stack Software Engineer (New graduates: United States)
description:
## This is a remote position.
Wanderlog is hiring a full-time engineer to help build and scale our web and mobile travel planning products. This is a permanent, full-time role reporting to the co-founders at Wanderlog.
Role details
Employment type: Full-time
Location: Remote — United States
Reports to: Co-founders
Salary range: $70,000 - $100,000 USD, depending on experience
## About Wanderlog
Wanderlog helps make leisure travel easier. We believe that travel makes the world better, and are building tools that lower the bar to it.
Our core product, built starting in 2019, is a travel planning app, but we’re also helping travelers book hotels (without hidden fees), providing them with information through pages such as best attractions and restaurants, and more.
We’re a small, engineering- and product-driven team building tools used by travelers worldwide.
Wanderlog was founded by twin brothers Peter Xu (ex-Stripe, McKinsey) and Harry Yu (ex-Google), who previously built successful travel products before starting Wanderlog.
What you'll do
As an engineer, you’ll be responsible for owning portions of the product. You’ll be expected to:
• Build new features on our website and mobile app. (Our stack is Javascript (Typescript): modern React on the web, React Native on mobile, and Node.js/Express on the server.)
• Design and decide what to build based on what would help travelers and drive growth. You won’t be handed a spec; you’ll be coming up with it!
• Build data pipelines to crawl, process, and synthesize data from various sources around the web.
• Write tests and build out engineering infrastructure. Our code is fully typed (Typescript) and tested.
• Debug and fix bugs and scale the infrastructure as it grows.
• Review code written by other engineers.
• Be fast and nimble: figure out the best way to build new features at the lowest cost in time and future technical debt.
What you might work on
• New, user-friendly hotel booking interfaces that make finding a place to stay easier.
• AI-powered tools that read articles and watch videos for you and summarize the places they mention.
• Improvements to our React Native mobile app so that it runs faster on slower Android phones.
• A Chrome extension to let travelers quickly compare possible places to visit, airfares, and hotels.
• Better invite and collaboration tools to encourage people to use Wanderlog to get more friends to join them.
• A better profile page that lets travelers on Wanderlog show off where they’ve been, see how many people they’ve helped, and follow other friends and their trips.
What it's like to work here
We’re an engineering- and product-heavy team. A typical week involves talking to users, prioritizing tasks, designing in Figma, and continuously building and shipping improvements.
Our values include putting travelers first, owning the product end-to-end, treating teammates with respect, and moving fast by being thoughtful about what we build.
We believe work should fit into your life. We also hold twice-annual travel off sites to collaborate more closely and enjoy visiting new places together.
Hiring process
• Two short asynchronous programming challenges, including an automated coding assessment
• A live coding interview with one of the founders
• A half-day final-round virtual onsite conducted via video call
## Requirements
• Are a Javascript developer comfortable with React and/or React Native.
• Are a product person: you’ve built products end-to-end before, and really care about the people who use them.
• Are comfortable with picking up various technologies for the task at hand. We quickly evaluate libraries and tools that could help our product, and variously use Redis, Elasticsearch, and Python as needed too.
• Are entrepreneurial: excited about joining a small, high-growth team and talking to users, doing product and design, and wearing a variety of hats.
